Sentence (English): I was very hopeful that this dishwasher would be the one.
Comments (English): [ DO NOT RECOMMEND ] || ---------------- || I was very hopeful that this dishwasher would be the one. When I pay $1000+ for anything, I have high expectations. At first, I was pleased that it matched my LG fridge, which I love. After looking at many brands and styles, this one had the best star review (4/6) and the 1 hour cycle caught my eye. The sleek look is appealing, the no fingerprint stainless is real and the music set up (when you press the buttons and when the cycle is over) is sweet and pleasant. The stainless inside looks great. The light inside was very useful and practical. The low decibel is amazing, I had to touch the dishwasher to feel if it was actually on. I have to say, how quiet it was, had to be my favorite thing about this dishwasher . You could not hear it one bit. Kuddos to LG for creating such a quiet dishwasher. I really wanted to love this dishwasher but whenever I would open it after a load was complete I would think: "I hate this dishwasher". Here are the reasons: There is a 1 hour option to select but the regular cycle is actually 2h40 minimum. The layout inside the unit doesn't allow for a lot of dishes, even with the utensils basket removed. I used to do a load every other day with my last dishwasher (a Whirlpool). With this LG, I had to do a load everyday. When I put the soap pod in the distributor, I would get stuck in it or a the top shelf so I started throwing the pod in the dishwasher and did not use the dispenser. What I hated the most, yes a strong word for me but that is the feeling I got every single time, is that this dishwasher doesn't dry the dishes, even after being in there for 2 hour plus. What the heck! I don't want to be spending another 1/2 hour drying my dishes by hand after each load or wait another few hours to let it "drip dry"! If I wanted to do that I would not need a dishwasher. I would a thousand dollar and wash all my dishes by hand and let it air dry overnight or dry them by hand. I could have lived and kept this dishwasher for the other negative reasons I have mentioned but for me the drying option was the deal breaker. Unfortunately, I am very disappointed with it and returning it for a Bosch. I hope I am making the right choice.

Sentence (English): We had to replace an old dishwasher and I chose this based on how we used our previous appliance.
Comments (English): [ Basic but works well ] || ---------------- || We had to replace an old dishwasher and I chose this based on how we used our previous appliance. We only ever used one setting (standard wash with heated dry) so I wasn't looking for a lot of programs. I have used the auto program most and it gets the dishes clean and dry in under 3 hours. I used the quick wash once which took about an hour, great for a few lightly soiled dishes. It's reasonably quiet too. Only 1 dish so far didn't come out spotless. but burnt on (twice in the oven) cheese on an old ceramic baking dish was a tough assignment! The silverware basket isn't ideal, could be taller to better hold longer knives safely, and the stemware rack only has 4 slots which is normally enough for us, but might not be if you use a lot of wine glasses. Overall a good value with great performance.

This was my 4 or 5th dishwasher and first & ….last ge….after getting more familiar with it and checking and rechecking everything…it has NOT impressed us at all! Very disappointed! After a heavy duty wash, about 240 minutes, with all the bells and whistles turned on…it STILL does a lousy job. Dishes do not get clean…even on the heaviest/longest wash cycle & we pre rinse…some still have to be washed 3 or 4 times or hand washed. Top rack is worthless for anything but maybe a rinse! The dishwasher does NOT even clean lids from insulated steel cups. Water lies in the recessed areas of the lids…there's no spray from the top to clean anything on it. The sliding rack comes apart and wheels fall off all the time. If they land down on the heating element, the cheap plastic wheels are goners! The water jets do not clean dirty cups, the dishwasher racks are made so it doesn't hold near the dishes like our old Whirlpool (circulating pump went bad) The “dry boost” feature does not dry the dishes…(again our old whirlpool danced circles around this one! ). The dishes were ALWAYS CLEAN, and ALWAYS DRY even on normal cycle…never had to use the HEAVY cycle like we do on this one! Thought we'd hear from the agent and be able to return it…we waited…. they NEVER called…Don't recommend the salespeople at Lowe's either…there's no way they didn't know about this machine being lousy! But they DID know that the machine had problems and had been out for 4 years… ot even a NEW machine. Plenty of time to “fix” the faulty stuff! Made in America sure doesn't mean what it used to! You all have been forewarned….I'm thinking the best machines were the ones they told us didn't have anyone to repair them if we had a problem…and the sad thing is…. Either died this one!

I would 100% get an appliance delivered and installed by Costco again.This Kitchenaid top control KDTM604KPS works great! The flatware rack is also the first I've ever used that actually lets our flatware be used with the separate lids which is so cool that nothing ever gets nested together anymore and they always get clean. We run it when we go to bed so I have yet to see the red light but I assume it's there lol. It's rated at 44db which was important to me and I can hear the first splash of water when it first starts but that's all. There's a very, very slight fan noise when it's drying that I hear only because our house is very quiet in the morning. I'm so happy with this dishwasher!

Comments (English): [ Washes/dries well but not energy-saver ] || ---------------- || We are happy with how it cleans, and it dries thoroughly without leaving spots. I am a little concerned about the strength of the door hinges when pulling out the bottom rack full of dishes - I hope it holds up long-term. The racking systems aren't well designed to maximize holding power - our 18 year old dishwasher it replaced was better designed in this way and held more dishes. As a result we are running it more often than our prior dishwasher. The run time is also much longer than our prior washer. The materials I read indicated a 2:30 run cycle. When I select the Sensor cycle it runs 3:23, when I select Normal cycle it is 3:06. I feel this washer is not as energy efficient as it should be given we are running it more often with a longer run cycle. Disappointing to me, I struggled to decide to reduce the rating by 1 or 2 points, 3.5 stars would be more accurate.

Comments (English): [ Happy wife, happy life. ] || ---------------- || My wife said she would give it 10 stars if she could and to be honest, it is a great dishwasher. Very well designed from the adjustable ladel holder in the cutlery level, height adjustable second level, and multi-adjustable rack stands (i.e. you can collapse every second stand in one motion to make the gap bigger so you can stand chunky dishes or bowls). We haven't tested the steam yet but everyone raves on about it being the best thing ever. So far, the machine has not let us down at all. The auto open function when it finishes is amazing too. The water hose has an in-line heater that cannot be detached. It was JUST ever so slightly bigger than the hole for us so I had to hacksaw an inch out from the first hole and dremel the hole under the sink slightly to make the hose fit. Not a huge deal - 5-10 minutes worth of work but just a heads up for those that have the small holes to feed the hoses and power cord through.

Sentence (English): This definitely is an superior upgrade to the 10 year old previous dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Quite, efficient, well made, with nice options ] || ---------------- || This definitely is an superior upgrade to the 10 year old previous dishwasher. This dishwasher promises a lot and delivers what it promises from quite operation to spotless dishes.Pro: - Quite operation, the 65 db is a low number but until the dishwasher is running I did not realize how low 65 db really is, its whisper quiet. You can just barely hear it filling or running.- The addition of the Running/Fault LED just below the handle is a nice change from the previous LED projected on the floor. - For us tea cups stained with tea and left almost empty all day were one of the poorest cleaned items with our previous dishwasher. With this dishwasher they come out spotless, clean as the day they were bought.- We have never had a third shelf and its taking a bit of adjustment for how we use it. I am finding that I load the silverware onto it with all the utensils on their side so they are not touching each other. In our previous dishwasher they were loaded into a basket for spoons and forks could touch and not always get fully clean.- Touch(not press) selection buttons. This took a couple of times to realize the selection area on the top of the door are not buttons in the old sense of something you press, but more a finger detection area that you glide over and that is all you need to do to make your selection.- When you select the power On the display on top of the door flashes with the options selected, very nice to have that confirmation of the options selected. When you select Run the display displays the options selected but stops flashing confirming you choices(nice feature). - After selecting Run and closing the door the white LED below the handle will either be On, or Flashing(indicating an issue that is preventing the dishwasher from running), or Off indicating the washer has completed its cycle or that Run was not selected before closing the door.Con:- None in multiple uses.Minor follow-up with the manufacturer on how to set some options with the app, such as how to enable remote start, and a few other features in the app.Suggested change to the side mounting bracket/clip.- The counter top above the dishwasher is granite and does not provide a place to attach the mounting clips making it necessary to use the clips on the side of the dishwasher. The previous dishwasher was made with physical holes slightly in from the side of the door allowing the mounting to be secured behind the edge of the adjacent cabinets. This would be a preferred mounting for me as screwing into the side of the adjacent cabinet face concerned me. I prefer the beefier mounting behind the cabinet face with a plastic plug inside the dishwasher covering the internal screw hole.

With this dishwasher they come out spotless, clean as the day they were bought.- We have never had a third shelf and its taking a bit of adjustment for how we use it. This would be a preferred mounting for me as screwing into the side of the adjacent cabinet face concerned me. Sentence (English): I bought it a few weeks ago and I am very satisfied.
Comments (English): [ Magnificent appliance! ] || ---------------- || I bought it a few weeks ago and I am very satisfied. Sentence (English): Replacing an old dishwasher, looking for an upgrade and so far been pleasantly satisfied.
Comments (English): [ Quiet and sleek ] || ---------------- || Replacing an old dishwasher, looking for an upgrade and so far been pleasantly satisfied. The only quibble is that the dishwasher does not (no longer) come with the electrical adapter to direct wire it, but only with a plug. This meant that I had to purchase the special Bosch junction box kit (from the plumber, at a premium) during installation, which was an unwelcome surprise. The other lesson learnt was the importance of using a rinse aid with this kind of modern dishwasher. Without it the dishes were still a bit wet, but with the rinse aid they come out sparkling clean and dry. Otherwise very happy, it runs so much quieter than my old machine, I like the sleek look (a red light appears on the floor to tell you it is running, but otherwise you wouldn't know). The racks are intuitive, though the bottom rack easily comes off its rails if you pull it out with the door not fully down. The third rack is nice, but not deep enough for larger objects.

Sentence (English): I love the quiet operation and optimal cleaning of this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Quiet, Superior Performance ] || ---------------- || I love the quiet operation and optimal cleaning of this dishwasher. The racks slide smoothly. The configuration of each rack and adjustability allows them to be easily loaded with dishes, bowls and pans of all sizes and shapes. The third rack has extra space to even accommodate small cereal bowls. The front handle is solid and great for hanging a towel. The operating buttons are on the top of the door out of the way of children. There is an info light that shines a red glow on the floor while the dishwasher is running. I would recommend to the designers to have that light glow green when the dishwasher is finished. The stainless steel finish so far has been easy to clean. I like that the digital readout tells me when the rinse aid needs to be replenished. I love the stainless steel interior. My only concern/complaint is at the end of two of the racks on the pull out handle there is a stainless steel engraved plate. This gets pushed against the door interior when closed causing a scratch and slight indentation into the inside of the door. However this does not affect the operation. I would highly recommend this model. Bosch makes a great product and stands behind it.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher is taking a bit of getting used to.
Comments (English): [ The Jury's Still Out ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher is taking a bit of getting used to. It does clean the dishes well and tolerates being heavily loaded. I figured that the Smart features would be over-the-top and useless - but didn't realize that this dishwasher relies on the app to let you know where in the cycle it is, and if the dishes are clean. Why would anyone want to control the dishwasher from their phone when you have to be there to put the detergent in? It's frustrating because without the app you really can't tell if it is running, or if the dishes are clean after the cycle is over. I also don't quite appreciate the top 3rd rack. Too bad this model doesn't have the floor light, or the clean indicator that other models have.

Sentence (English): We bought a Bosch back in 2011 and it served us well until 2023, when the racks were found to be extensively rusted.
Comments (English): [ Good but not great ] || ---------------- || We bought a Bosch back in 2011 and it served us well until 2023, when the racks were found to be extensively rusted. Based on the great experience all those years, we bought this dishwasher feeling very confident. This model feels substantially flimsier than the old one. The bottom rack doesn't have a definitive track on the right side, so it often balks when you try to roll it in. The only way to use the top rack with stemmed glasses on the second rack, is to lower the second rack which limits the height of what can go in on the bottom rack. Frankly, the top rack just seems silly. I'd rather have sturdier utensil baskets on the bottom rack. The fold-down holders for stemmed glasses don't lock as decisively in place as the ones on our old washer did. Having the controls on top panel means you can't see what's going on after you close the top. There is a little red light on the bottom that tells you when the washer is in operation, but it doesn't display the remaining time or show what kind of cycle has been set. The buttons on the controls don't have hapatic feedback. It's very easy to accidently turn on the washer when closing it up. I'm also worried about the plumbing connection to the middle rack which gets disconnected everytime you pull it out. After only having it for a few weeks, the top gasket just fell out. Easy enough to snap back in, but not very reassuring. It does clean the dishes and doesn't leak so the basics are covered, but I expected more from Bosch.

Sentence (English): This is a solid dishwasher (from what I can tell so far); modern, sleek, quiet.
Comments (English): [ Sleek and quiet but I wish Costco disclosed more ] || ---------------- || This is a solid dishwasher (from what I can tell so far); modern, sleek, quiet. But some caveats to be aware of when ordering from Costco. The deal seems good (and may be so) because installation and delivery/haul-away are included, which otherwise could be $200+ at other stores. But the information provided was not great: meaning that there were two unexpected costs that left a surprised aftertaste to the purchase. One; the plumber assigned by Costco to do the installation (the appliance was dropped off on-time, without issues, the day before) informed me that there would be a $60+ local "permit fee" that I had never heard of and could never confirm through the city inspectors office. More relevant was that Bosch no longer includes the electric junction box in their dishwasher kit, and this means that if you have a direct wired dishwasher (which I did), then this cannot be connected to your electrical, without purchasing this extra little box. This is not the main critique, as if I knew (i.e. if Costco clearly states this) - then I could have ordered/purchased this box in advance for $20. Unfortunately, because this also was not clearly disclosed (and I'm guessing the plumber, who would also know this was a likely problem, chose not to mention it up front) - I had to purchase it off the plumber's own "truck" for a 250% markup! This is very frustrating and could have been avoided by a simple disclosure by Costco (I believe other box stores did do this for the same product). Otherwise, the installation went fine, and the dishwasher works well, except that i realized you definitely need rinse aid to make the dishes come out dry. Happy with my purchase, just not the cost (also, the cost went down $100+ a few days after I bought it, and I was not able to recoup the sale price). So an expensive dishwasher that does a nice job.

Sentence (English): Well I have to make my review on this dishwasher, but first I have to say my previous Whirlpool TOL dishwasher which was 30 years old could run circles around this new machine.
Comments (English): [ A Nice Machine ] || ---------------- || Well I have to make my review on this dishwasher, but first I have to say my previous Whirlpool TOL dishwasher which was 30 years old could run circles around this new machine. The reason it had to be replaced was that the computer board went out and was no longer available to replace it so the machine had to be replaced. I have to say I really got good service from that machine. Now to review this new machine I will give my opinion on what are the pros and cons of this dishwasher. The Pros, The machine has 3 racks for washing items that go into the machine, the middle rack adjusts up and down for different size items and it does hold a lot of dishes and glasses. I also like the option of just washing 2 racks instead of all 3. It has a large cutlery basket in the lower rack, along with a cutlery rack in the very top rack for odd pieces which is nice. When the machine is running it is quiet and so far everything that has gone in it(dishes and glasses) have come out clean, I haven't put any pots in it as I am not sure it will get them clean as my old machine did. It is still a learning curve with this machine as it is new and has a different layout from my old machine. The Cons, I wish the control panel in the front of the machine was more informative, just telling me it is washing with 10 dashes is very lax in information as to what portion the cycle is in. For the price of this machine it should be telling you what portion of the cycle it is in, is it washing, rinsing, water heating and if you can add a dish to the machine like my old machine did. I always set the water heat option to on and this extends the cycle time for 30 minutes as my hot water heater is not close by the kitchen. The instruction book doesn't tell you if the heater is on during the washing cycle. The drying portion of the cycle is short unless you choose to extend the drying portion which adds 14 minutes to the drying cycle. The first time I ran the machine at the end of the cycle everything was wet, so I always choose to extend the drying cycle. I know the government is responsible for cutting the water use in (dishwasher/washing machines, etc) and that the machine uses very little water as a result it extends the cycle times for all cycles except Express Wash to over 3 hours to wash a load of dishes. This use of so little water in the machine only allows one wash arm to run at a time. Maybe I am being picky, but the machine seems to waste time (up to a minute) in making a decision as to what wash arm to run next. Also, I am hesitant to put pots in this machine as I don't think that it has the power to get them clean like my old machine did. One last thing, I know for sure that this machine will not last as long as my old one did, if I get 8 to 10 years out of it I will be lucky. In closing, it's a new learning experience with this new machine versus my old one, one that I will have to get use to using, and running it at night when it can take all the time it wants to wash the dishes.

Installation: I contacted the technician in advance before he came and prepared the space in advance, but it was narrower than I thought, so the technician did this and that, so he made the space like this so that I could use it comfortably! ~ *If you want quick installation, it's better to check the space with a tape measure before you come! ***** Now I'll tell you the good and bad points! I thought that if the dishes were for 6 people, only soup bowls, rice bowls, and 6-person plates would fit, but I was surprised that it held more than I thought! It's the best. Sentence (English): After much thought, I decided to install the dishwasher and chose a product that can be installed on Coupang Rocket.
Comments (English): After much thought, I decided to install the dishwasher and chose a product that can be installed on Coupang Rocket. In conclusion, I am satisfied and using it well, so I regret the time I spent worrying. So I am leaving a review. Advantages of Rocket Installation: You can specify the desired delivery date! However, you can schedule a time by calling the technician the day before you specify. Sink Reform: The day before the dishwasher installation, the technician will visit you first to check the place where the dishwasher will be installed and set it up. Fortunately, my house has a sink that matches the size of the dishwasher, so it was easy to proceed. Depending on the situation, additional costs may apply for the sink reform, and only card payment is possible. It took about 45 minutes, and the technician took care of the entire sink in addition to the place where the dishwasher was installed. He straightened the part where the door was slightly tilted, which I didn't even realize while using it. The part that needed cutting was done in the hallway. There was some sawdust, but he cleaned it up, so I just cleaned up the rest. Dishwasher Installation: The dishwasher installation the day after the sink reform also took about 30 minutes. The dishwasher was installed just right and I like it because it's neat. User review: First of all, I really like that it doesn't take much time to wash the dishes. Of course, you have to do a pre-wash before putting the dishes in the dishwasher, but it's just to remove food, so you can finish it quickly. At first, it took a while to stack the dishes in the dishwasher, but now it's easy. It takes about 2 hours and 48 minutes when you run the full cycle, and the door opens when it's done. However, the drying is not 100% perfect, so I leave the door wide open and move the dishes to the dish rack after they are completely dry. I usually use the dishwasher after dinner, and it makes a sound that's not annoying when it's running. If you're worried about noise between floors, don't worry because it's not loud enough to cause noise between floors. I'm using it with great satisfaction!
Comments (Original): 고민하다가 식세기 설치하기로 맘먹고 쿠팡로켓설치 가능한 제품으로 골랐어요.  결론은 고민했던 시간이 아까울 만큼 만족하면서 잘 쓰고 있습니다. 그래서 후기 남겨요.  ✔️로켓설치 장점 : 원하는 배송일 지정가능합니다!! 다만 시간대는 지정한 전날 방문 기사님이랑 통화해서 시간 잡을 수 있습니다. ✔️싱크대 리폼 : 식세기 설치 전날, 리폼 기사님이 먼저 방문하셔서 식세기를 설치할 자리를 점검하고 셋팅을 해주십니다. 다행히 저희집은 식세기 사이즈와 맞는 규격 싱크대장이 있어서 수월하게 진행 가능했어요. 상황에 따라 싱크대 리폼에 추가비용은 발생할 수 있고 카드결제만 가능합니다. 약 45분정도 걸렸고 기사님께서 식세기 설치하는 곳 외에도 싱크대를 전체적으로 손봐주셨어요. 사용하면서도 인지하지 못했을 정도로 문짝이 살짝 기울어진 부분을 바로잡아 주셨네요. 절단이 필요한 부분은 복도에서 진행해주셨어요. 톱밥이 좀 나오긴 했지만 정리를 해주고 가셔서 저는 나머지 부분만 추가로 정리했습니다. ✔️식세기 설치 : 싱크대 리폼 다음날 식세기 설치도 약 30분 정도 소요됐습니다. 아주 알맞게 식세기 설치 완료되었고 깔끔해서 맘에 들어요. ✔️사용후기 : 일단 설거지 하는데 시간이 안들어서 너무 좋아요. 물론 식세기에 그릇 넣기 전 애벌설거지는 해야하지만 음식물을 제거하는 정도여서 금방 끝낼 수 있어요.  처음에는 그릇을 식세기에 쌓아 넣는데 시간이 좀 걸렸는데 이젠 척척 합니다. 풀코스로 돌리면 약 2시간 48분이 소요되는데 끝나고 나면 문이 열려요. 그런데 건조는 100% 완벽하진 않아서 저는 문을 활짝 열어두고 그릇을 다 말린 후 그릇장으로 옮깁니다. 주로 저녁식사 후 식세기를 사용하는데 작동할때 거슬리지 않을 정도의 소리가 나긴합니다. 혹시나 층간소음이 걱정되신다면 층간소음을 유발할 정도의 소리는 아니니 고민하지 마세요. 대만족하면서 사용중입니다!

First of all, it says it's for 12 people, but I run the dishwasher with the dishes used in a day for two people. It says it's for one day, but I eat about two meals a day, and even if I just run it with a frying pan I cooked in, it's full quickly. I think you should think of it as for 6 people and buy it. ~ If you're good at Tetris, you can put in a lot, but the dishwashing function is significantly reduced. There was still foreign matter in the bowl. So, if you put the bowl with the foreign matter on it as much as possible, it will be really clean. If you put it like that, not many bowls will fit, and the frying pan covered in oil will be cleaned and come out clean. However, hardened carbon stains? These sometimes remain, so I wiped them off with a kitchen towel and put them back in. If you think the foreign matter has hardened, you can turn it on with steam to clean it well. *** One thing that was inconvenient was that water leaked from the dishwasher once. I still don't know the cause, but when I stopped washing and opened it, there was no drainage at all inside. There was no foreign matter in the drain, so I don't know why it happened. Please give me a try ~

Sentence (English): It's been two weeks since I've been with Auntie Dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ A hard-working aunt from 2020 ] || ---------------- || It's been two weeks since I've been with Auntie Dishwasher. During the Lunar New Year holiday, I was cooking various dishes at home and washing dishes when suddenly I got a dishwasher. I went to the department store that day and saw LG and Samsung dishwashers, but both of them cost 1.7 million won. 'I'm the only one who doesn't have a dishwasher. ' I searched Coupang and found a good dishwasher for 700,000 won (with card discount). I thought something was strange and checked the details page, but this product was a 2020 model. The department store was a 2021 model. I asked a department store employee for nearly an hour and asked them carefully. I will start a comparative review between the 2021 model and the 2020 model that I actually used for 2 weeks. The review was written in the order of [Pros], [Cons], and [Overall]. [Pros] - It is cheap. It is about 1 million won cheaper than the 2021 model, but there were three major differences between the two. 1. Addition of a dedicated cutlery tray at the top. The 2020 product was washed by placing the cutlery container in the bottom pot washing compartment, which was a bit disappointing. In the 12-person lower pot tray, excluding the cutlery container, you can put in 1 28cm wok, 1 30cm pan, 1 air fryer inner pot & oil pan, and 1 pan lid. However, if you put in a spoon holder, the size is ambiguous, so you have to take one or two out. The size of the spoon holder is not large, but it is the main reason why the difficulty of Tetris increases rapidly. Also, you have to be careful about where you put the spoons in so that they do not stick to each other in the spoon tray, which is inconvenient. Also, since it is a vertically inserted method, long items such as chopsticks for frying or a spatula get caught on the watering can in the middle and cannot be put in. The 2021 model has a 3-tier tray dedicated to cutlery, so it is convenient because you can just unfold it. 1. Application of water softener filter The 2021 products include a water softener function. Comments (English): [ A hard-working aunt from 2020 ] || ---------------- || It's been two weeks since I've been with Auntie Dishwasher. During the Lunar New Year holiday, I was cooking various dishes at home and washing dishes when suddenly I got a dishwasher. I went to the department store that day and saw LG and Samsung dishwashers, but both of them cost 1.7 million won. 'I'm the only one who doesn't have a dishwasher. ' I searched Coupang and found a good dishwasher for 700,000 won (with card discount). I thought something was strange and checked the details page, but this product was a 2020 model. The department store was a 2021 model. I asked a department store employee for nearly an hour and asked them carefully. I will start a comparative review between the 2021 model and the 2020 model that I actually used for 2 weeks. The review was written in the order of [Pros], [Cons], and [Overall]. [Pros] - It is cheap. It is about 1 million won cheaper than the 2021 model, but there were three major differences between the two. 1. Addition of a dedicated cutlery tray at the top. The 2020 product was washed by placing the cutlery container in the bottom pot washing compartment, which was a bit disappointing. In the 12-person lower pot tray, excluding the cutlery container, you can put in 1 28cm wok, 1 30cm pan, 1 air fryer inner pot & oil pan, and 1 pan lid. However, if you put in a spoon holder, the size is ambiguous, so you have to take one or two out. The size of the spoon holder is not large, but it is the main reason why the difficulty of Tetris increases rapidly. Also, you have to be careful about where you put the spoons in so that they do not stick to each other in the spoon tray, which is inconvenient. Also, since it is a vertically inserted method, long items such as chopsticks for frying or a spatula get caught on the watering can in the middle and cannot be put in. The 2021 model has a 3-tier tray dedicated to cutlery, so it is convenient because you can just unfold it. 1. Application of water softener filter The 2021 products include a water softener function. Was it LG or Samsung? One company purchased a water softener filter, and the other company only added salt to use it, so the two companies had different forms. However, in places with poor water quality such as Europe or Southeast Asia, a water softener function may be necessary, but is it really necessary in Korea? 3. Without removing the mop holder. For those who live in a rented house, cutting the mop holder can be a problem, but the 2021 model can be installed without cutting the mop holder. The 2020 model must be cut. The three things above were big differences, but in my case, they were shortcomings that I could overlook, so I chose the 2020 model. - Bravo cleaning power I was a distruster of dishwashers, but after actually using it, I found out that it had satisfactory cleaning power. At first, I used to wash it beforehand, but I got lazy and stopped doing that. In particular, I fell in love with the cleaning power when I saw that it completely washed away stubborn grease, such as from air fryer whole pork belly. When I first used it because I was not good at dish Tetris, I was embarrassed because there were some places that weren't cleaned, but after arranging the dishes to match the water nozzle and washing them, they became very clean. - Free time. In the past, I used to wash the dishes for lunch and dinner separately. However, when I used the dishwasher, After purchasing it, I have been saving up enough for two meals and running it at once. After dinner, I just throw the dishes in the dishwasher, finish watching Netflix, and when I come out of the shower, I can see the washed dishes shortly - less burden from dishes piling up. Since I can wash pots and dishes without getting my hands wet even if I use them a lot, I don't feel burdened by using new dishes. Since the dishwasher aunt came, there are many cases where all the woks and pans in the house are mobilized. [Cons] - Washing dishes by hand has become a very, very, very annoying thing. In the past, I used to wash the dishes right after eating, but these days, washing dishes by hand is so annoying. Plastic containers, cutting boards, knives, scissors, etc. that cannot be dishwashed must be washed by hand, which is very annoying. I am looking into replacing all of them with dishwasher-safe products. - The washing time is quite long. If you run the regular course, it takes about an hour and a half. On oily days, if you run the soaking + strong wash, it takes more than 2 hours. If you eat dinner early and run it, it does not matter much, but if you eat dinner late, you may wonder what you are doing after running the dishwasher and rubbing your sleepy eyes. - Regrettable drying Drying is done by blowing the wind once to blow away the moisture, and then evaporating the moisture at high temperature. Since it only evaporates the moisture, the drying effect is greatly reduced if water is accumulated. If water is accumulated in the concave area at the bottom of the dish, the moisture in that area remains. Regular drying takes about 5 minutes, and most cups and dishes dry well. However, about 50% are dried well, and half of them have one or two drops of water, so it is difficult to put them in the cupboard right away. If you run the strong dry mode, it will dry for 30 minutes, and 80-90% of the items will be dried well, and only a small amount of laundry will have moisture left. I don't want to bother checking whether it's dry or not, so I use the normal dry mode for drying, and after washing, I put it on a drying tray and let it dry naturally. [Overall] - Buy 30 minutes to 1 hour of free time every day with money - If you're not a single-person household, the dishwasher is an unbeatable 12-person option - It's a good choice if you can overlook some of the shortcomings. Note - If you want to install it under the cooking range, it doesn't matter if you use a gas range, but if you use an induction or highlight, they say there's an additional cost for adding insulation between the dishwasher. - If you tell the installer about the lower cabinet of the sink that was removed during installation, they will collect it for free. - The furniture installer first visits for the installation, disassembling the lower cabinet, wiring, and cutting the hole under the sink. Then, the dishwasher installer comes 1-2 days later. There was no installation fee or delivery fee. Comments (English): [ A hard-working aunt from 2020 ] || ---------------- || It's been two weeks since I've been with Auntie Dishwasher. During the Lunar New Year holiday, I was cooking various dishes at home and washing dishes when suddenly I got a dishwasher. I went to the department store that day and saw LG and Samsung dishwashers, but both of them cost 1.7 million won. 'I'm the only one who doesn't have a dishwasher. ' I searched Coupang and found a good dishwasher for 700,000 won (with card discount). I thought something was strange and checked the details page, but this product was a 2020 model. The department store was a 2021 model. I asked a department store employee for nearly an hour and asked them carefully. I will start a comparative review between the 2021 model and the 2020 model that I actually used for 2 weeks. The review was written in the order of [Pros], [Cons], and [Overall]. [Pros] - It is cheap. It is about 1 million won cheaper than the 2021 model, but there were three major differences between the two. 1. Addition of a dedicated cutlery tray at the top. The 2020 product was washed by placing the cutlery container in the bottom pot washing compartment, which was a bit disappointing. In the 12-person lower pot tray, excluding the cutlery container, you can put in 1 28cm wok, 1 30cm pan, 1 air fryer inner pot & oil pan, and 1 pan lid. However, if you put in a spoon holder, the size is ambiguous, so you have to take one or two out. The size of the spoon holder is not large, but it is the main reason why the difficulty of Tetris increases rapidly. Also, you have to be careful about where you put the spoons in so that they do not stick to each other in the spoon tray, which is inconvenient. Also, since it is a vertically inserted method, long items such as chopsticks for frying or a spatula get caught on the watering can in the middle and cannot be put in. The 2021 model has a 3-tier tray dedicated to cutlery, so it is convenient because you can just unfold it. 1. Application of water softener filter The 2021 products include a water softener function. Was it LG or Samsung? One company purchased a water softener filter, and the other company only added salt to use it, so the two companies had different forms. However, in places with poor water quality such as Europe or Southeast Asia, a water softener function may be necessary, but is it really necessary in Korea? 3. Without removing the mop holder. For those who live in a rented house, cutting the mop holder can be a problem, but the 2021 model can be installed without cutting the mop holder. The 2020 model must be cut. The three things above were big differences, but in my case, they were shortcomings that I could overlook, so I chose the 2020 model. - Bravo cleaning power I was a distruster of dishwashers, but after actually using it, I found out that it had satisfactory cleaning power. At first, I used to wash it beforehand, but I got lazy and stopped doing that. In particular, I fell in love with the cleaning power when I saw that it completely washed away stubborn grease, such as from air fryer whole pork belly. When I first used it because I was not good at dish Tetris, I was embarrassed because there were some places that weren't cleaned, but after arranging the dishes to match the water nozzle and washing them, they became very clean. - Free time. In the past, I used to wash the dishes for lunch and dinner separately. However, when I used the dishwasher, After purchasing it, I have been saving up enough for two meals and running it at once. After dinner, I just throw the dishes in the dishwasher, finish watching Netflix, and when I come out of the shower, I can see the washed dishes shortly - less burden from dishes piling up. Since I can wash pots and dishes without getting my hands wet even if I use them a lot, I don't feel burdened by using new dishes. Since the dishwasher aunt came, there are many cases where all the woks and pans in the house are mobilized. [Cons] - Washing dishes by hand has become a very, very, very annoying thing. In the past, I used to wash the dishes right after eating, but these days, washing dishes by hand is so annoying. Plastic containers, cutting boards, knives, scissors, etc. that cannot be dishwashed must be washed by hand, which is very annoying. I am looking into replacing all of them with dishwasher-safe products. - The washing time is quite long. If you run the regular course, it takes about an hour and a half. On oily days, if you run the soaking + strong wash, it takes more than 2 hours. If you eat dinner early and run it, it does not matter much, but if you eat dinner late, you may wonder what you are doing after running the dishwasher and rubbing your sleepy eyes. - Regrettable drying Drying is done by blowing the wind once to blow away the moisture, and then evaporating the moisture at high temperature. Since it only evaporates the moisture, the drying effect is greatly reduced if water is accumulated. If water is accumulated in the concave area at the bottom of the dish, the moisture in that area remains. Regular drying takes about 5 minutes, and most cups and dishes dry well. However, about 50% are dried well, and half of them have one or two drops of water, so it is difficult to put them in the cupboard right away. If you run the strong dry mode, it will dry for 30 minutes, and 80-90% of the items will be dried well, and only a small amount of laundry will have moisture left. I don't want to bother checking whether it's dry or not, so I use the normal dry mode for drying, and after washing, I put it on a drying tray and let it dry naturally. [Overall] - Buy 30 minutes to 1 hour of free time every day with money - If you're not a single-person household, the dishwasher is an unbeatable 12-person option - It's a good choice if you can overlook some of the shortcomings. Note - If you want to install it under the cooking range, it doesn't matter if you use a gas range, but if you use an induction or highlight, they say there's an additional cost for adding insulation between the dishwasher. - If you tell the installer about the lower cabinet of the sink that was removed during installation, they will collect it for free. - The furniture installer first visits for the installation, disassembling the lower cabinet, wiring, and cutting the hole under the sink. Then, the dishwasher installer comes 1-2 days later. There was no installation fee or delivery fee. If you request a previous installation + reassemble the lower cabinet, it will cost around 100,000 won. It is said that an amount of money of that level is generated

Comments (English): [ A hard-working aunt from 2020 ] || ---------------- || It's been two weeks since I've been with Auntie Dishwasher. During the Lunar New Year holiday, I was cooking various dishes at home and washing dishes when suddenly I got a dishwasher. I went to the department store that day and saw LG and Samsung dishwashers, but both of them cost 1.7 million won. 'I'm the only one who doesn't have a dishwasher. ' I searched Coupang and found a good dishwasher for 700,000 won (with card discount). I thought something was strange and checked the details page, but this product was a 2020 model. The department store was a 2021 model. I asked a department store employee for nearly an hour and asked them carefully. I will start a comparative review between the 2021 model and the 2020 model that I actually used for 2 weeks. The review was written in the order of [Pros], [Cons], and [Overall]. [Pros] - It is cheap. It is about 1 million won cheaper than the 2021 model, but there were three major differences between the two. 1. Addition of a dedicated cutlery tray at the top. The 2020 product was washed by placing the cutlery container in the bottom pot washing compartment, which was a bit disappointing. In the 12-person lower pot tray, excluding the cutlery container, you can put in 1 28cm wok, 1 30cm pan, 1 air fryer inner pot & oil pan, and 1 pan lid. However, if you put in a spoon holder, the size is ambiguous, so you have to take one or two out. The size of the spoon holder is not large, but it is the main reason why the difficulty of Tetris increases rapidly. Also, you have to be careful about where you put the spoons in so that they do not stick to each other in the spoon tray, which is inconvenient. Also, since it is a vertically inserted method, long items such as chopsticks for frying or a spatula get caught on the watering can in the middle and cannot be put in. The 2021 model has a 3-tier tray dedicated to cutlery, so it is convenient because you can just unfold it. 1. Application of water softener filter The 2021 products include a water softener function. Was it LG or Samsung? One company purchased a water softener filter, and the other company only added salt to use it, so the two companies had different forms. However, in places with poor water quality such as Europe or Southeast Asia, a water softener function may be necessary, but is it really necessary in Korea? 3. Without removing the mop holder. For those who live in a rented house, cutting the mop holder can be a problem, but the 2021 model can be installed without cutting the mop holder. The 2020 model must be cut. The three things above were big differences, but in my case, they were shortcomings that I could overlook, so I chose the 2020 model. - Bravo cleaning power I was a distruster of dishwashers, but after actually using it, I found out that it had satisfactory cleaning power. At first, I used to wash it beforehand, but I got lazy and stopped doing that. In particular, I fell in love with the cleaning power when I saw that it completely washed away stubborn grease, such as from air fryer whole pork belly. When I first used it because I was not good at dish Tetris, I was embarrassed because there were some places that weren't cleaned, but after arranging the dishes to match the water nozzle and washing them, they became very clean. - Free time. In the past, I used to wash the dishes for lunch and dinner separately. However, when I used the dishwasher, After purchasing it, I have been saving up enough for two meals and running it at once. After dinner, I just throw the dishes in the dishwasher, finish watching Netflix, and when I come out of the shower, I can see the washed dishes shortly - less burden from dishes piling up. Since I can wash pots and dishes without getting my hands wet even if I use them a lot, I don't feel burdened by using new dishes. Since the dishwasher aunt came, there are many cases where all the woks and pans in the house are mobilized. [Cons] - Washing dishes by hand has become a very, very, very annoying thing. In the past, I used to wash the dishes right after eating, but these days, washing dishes by hand is so annoying. Plastic containers, cutting boards, knives, scissors, etc. that cannot be dishwashed must be washed by hand, which is very annoying. I am looking into replacing all of them with dishwasher-safe products. - The washing time is quite long. If you run the regular course, it takes about an hour and a half. On oily days, if you run the soaking + strong wash, it takes more than 2 hours. If you eat dinner early and run it, it does not matter much, but if you eat dinner late, you may wonder what you are doing after running the dishwasher and rubbing your sleepy eyes. - Regrettable drying Drying is done by blowing the wind once to blow away the moisture, and then evaporating the moisture at high temperature. Since it only evaporates the moisture, the drying effect is greatly reduced if water is accumulated. If water is accumulated in the concave area at the bottom of the dish, the moisture in that area remains. Regular drying takes about 5 minutes, and most cups and dishes dry well. However, about 50% are dried well, and half of them have one or two drops of water, so it is difficult to put them in the cupboard right away. If you run the strong dry mode, it will dry for 30 minutes, and 80-90% of the items will be dried well, and only a small amount of laundry will have moisture left. I don't want to bother checking whether it's dry or not, so I use the normal dry mode for drying, and after washing, I put it on a drying tray and let it dry naturally. [Overall] - Buy 30 minutes to 1 hour of free time every day with money - If you're not a single-person household, the dishwasher is an unbeatable 12-person option - It's a good choice if you can overlook some of the shortcomings. Note - If you want to install it under the cooking range, it doesn't matter if you use a gas range, but if you use an induction or highlight, they say there's an additional cost for adding insulation between the dishwasher. - If you tell the installer about the lower cabinet of the sink that was removed during installation, they will collect it for free. - The furniture installer first visits for the installation, disassembling the lower cabinet, wiring, and cutting the hole under the sink. Then, the dishwasher installer comes 1-2 days later. There was no installation fee or delivery fee. Sentence (English): I searched Coupang and found a good dishwasher for 700,000 won (with card discount).
Comments (English): [ A hard-working aunt from 2020 ] || ---------------- || It's been two weeks since I've been with Auntie Dishwasher. During the Lunar New Year holiday, I was cooking various dishes at home and washing dishes when suddenly I got a dishwasher. I went to the department store that day and saw LG and Samsung dishwashers, but both of them cost 1.7 million won. 'I'm the only one who doesn't have a dishwasher. ' I searched Coupang and found a good dishwasher for 700,000 won (with card discount). I thought something was strange and checked the details page, but this product was a 2020 model. The department store was a 2021 model. I asked a department store employee for nearly an hour and asked them carefully. I will start a comparative review between the 2021 model and the 2020 model that I actually used for 2 weeks. The review was written in the order of [Pros], [Cons], and [Overall]. [Pros] - It is cheap. It is about 1 million won cheaper than the 2021 model, but there were three major differences between the two. 1. Addition of a dedicated cutlery tray at the top. The 2020 product was washed by placing the cutlery container in the bottom pot washing compartment, which was a bit disappointing. In the 12-person lower pot tray, excluding the cutlery container, you can put in 1 28cm wok, 1 30cm pan, 1 air fryer inner pot & oil pan, and 1 pan lid. However, if you put in a spoon holder, the size is ambiguous, so you have to take one or two out. The size of the spoon holder is not large, but it is the main reason why the difficulty of Tetris increases rapidly. Also, you have to be careful about where you put the spoons in so that they do not stick to each other in the spoon tray, which is inconvenient. Also, since it is a vertically inserted method, long items such as chopsticks for frying or a spatula get caught on the watering can in the middle and cannot be put in. The 2021 model has a 3-tier tray dedicated to cutlery, so it is convenient because you can just unfold it. 1. Application of water softener filter The 2021 products include a water softener function. Was it LG or Samsung? One company purchased a water softener filter, and the other company only added salt to use it, so the two companies had different forms. However, in places with poor water quality such as Europe or Southeast Asia, a water softener function may be necessary, but is it really necessary in Korea? 3. Without removing the mop holder. For those who live in a rented house, cutting the mop holder can be a problem, but the 2021 model can be installed without cutting the mop holder. The 2020 model must be cut. The three things above were big differences, but in my case, they were shortcomings that I could overlook, so I chose the 2020 model. - Bravo cleaning power I was a distruster of dishwashers, but after actually using it, I found out that it had satisfactory cleaning power. At first, I used to wash it beforehand, but I got lazy and stopped doing that. In particular, I fell in love with the cleaning power when I saw that it completely washed away stubborn grease, such as from air fryer whole pork belly. When I first used it because I was not good at dish Tetris, I was embarrassed because there were some places that weren't cleaned, but after arranging the dishes to match the water nozzle and washing them, they became very clean. - Free time. In the past, I used to wash the dishes for lunch and dinner separately. However, when I used the dishwasher, After purchasing it, I have been saving up enough for two meals and running it at once. After dinner, I just throw the dishes in the dishwasher, finish watching Netflix, and when I come out of the shower, I can see the washed dishes shortly - less burden from dishes piling up. Since I can wash pots and dishes without getting my hands wet even if I use them a lot, I don't feel burdened by using new dishes. Since the dishwasher aunt came, there are many cases where all the woks and pans in the house are mobilized. [Cons] - Washing dishes by hand has become a very, very, very annoying thing. In the past, I used to wash the dishes right after eating, but these days, washing dishes by hand is so annoying. Plastic containers, cutting boards, knives, scissors, etc. that cannot be dishwashed must be washed by hand, which is very annoying. I am looking into replacing all of them with dishwasher-safe products. - The washing time is quite long. If you run the regular course, it takes about an hour and a half. On oily days, if you run the soaking + strong wash, it takes more than 2 hours. If you eat dinner early and run it, it does not matter much, but if you eat dinner late, you may wonder what you are doing after running the dishwasher and rubbing your sleepy eyes. - Regrettable drying Drying is done by blowing the wind once to blow away the moisture, and then evaporating the moisture at high temperature. Since it only evaporates the moisture, the drying effect is greatly reduced if water is accumulated. If water is accumulated in the concave area at the bottom of the dish, the moisture in that area remains. Regular drying takes about 5 minutes, and most cups and dishes dry well. However, about 50% are dried well, and half of them have one or two drops of water, so it is difficult to put them in the cupboard right away. If you run the strong dry mode, it will dry for 30 minutes, and 80-90% of the items will be dried well, and only a small amount of laundry will have moisture left. I don't want to bother checking whether it's dry or not, so I use the normal dry mode for drying, and after washing, I put it on a drying tray and let it dry naturally. [Overall] - Buy 30 minutes to 1 hour of free time every day with money - If you're not a single-person household, the dishwasher is an unbeatable 12-person option - It's a good choice if you can overlook some of the shortcomings. Note - If you want to install it under the cooking range, it doesn't matter if you use a gas range, but if you use an induction or highlight, they say there's an additional cost for adding insulation between the dishwasher. - If you tell the installer about the lower cabinet of the sink that was removed during installation, they will collect it for free. - The furniture installer first visits for the installation, disassembling the lower cabinet, wiring, and cutting the hole under the sink. Then, the dishwasher installer comes 1-2 days later. There was no installation fee or delivery fee. If you request a previous installation + reassemble the lower cabinet, it will cost around 100,000 won. It is said that an amount of money of that level is generated

Comments (English): [ A hard-working aunt from 2020 ] || ---------------- || It's been two weeks since I've been with Auntie Dishwasher. During the Lunar New Year holiday, I was cooking various dishes at home and washing dishes when suddenly I got a dishwasher. I went to the department store that day and saw LG and Samsung dishwashers, but both of them cost 1.7 million won. 'I'm the only one who doesn't have a dishwasher. ' I searched Coupang and found a good dishwasher for 700,000 won (with card discount). I thought something was strange and checked the details page, but this product was a 2020 model. The department store was a 2021 model. I asked a department store employee for nearly an hour and asked them carefully. I will start a comparative review between the 2021 model and the 2020 model that I actually used for 2 weeks. The review was written in the order of [Pros], [Cons], and [Overall]. [Pros] - It is cheap. It is about 1 million won cheaper than the 2021 model, but there were three major differences between the two. 1. Addition of a dedicated cutlery tray at the top. The 2020 product was washed by placing the cutlery container in the bottom pot washing compartment, which was a bit disappointing. In the 12-person lower pot tray, excluding the cutlery container, you can put in 1 28cm wok, 1 30cm pan, 1 air fryer inner pot & oil pan, and 1 pan lid. However, if you put in a spoon holder, the size is ambiguous, so you have to take one or two out. The size of the spoon holder is not large, but it is the main reason why the difficulty of Tetris increases rapidly. Also, you have to be careful about where you put the spoons in so that they do not stick to each other in the spoon tray, which is inconvenient. Also, since it is a vertically inserted method, long items such as chopsticks for frying or a spatula get caught on the watering can in the middle and cannot be put in. The 2021 model has a 3-tier tray dedicated to cutlery, so it is convenient because you can just unfold it. 1. Application of water softener filter The 2021 products include a water softener function. Was it LG or Samsung? One company purchased a water softener filter, and the other company only added salt to use it, so the two companies had different forms. However, in places with poor water quality such as Europe or Southeast Asia, a water softener function may be necessary, but is it really necessary in Korea? 3. Without removing the mop holder. For those who live in a rented house, cutting the mop holder can be a problem, but the 2021 model can be installed without cutting the mop holder. The 2020 model must be cut. The three things above were big differences, but in my case, they were shortcomings that I could overlook, so I chose the 2020 model. - Bravo cleaning power I was a distruster of dishwashers, but after actually using it, I found out that it had satisfactory cleaning power. At first, I used to wash it beforehand, but I got lazy and stopped doing that. In particular, I fell in love with the cleaning power when I saw that it completely washed away stubborn grease, such as from air fryer whole pork belly. When I first used it because I was not good at dish Tetris, I was embarrassed because there were some places that weren't cleaned, but after arranging the dishes to match the water nozzle and washing them, they became very clean. - Free time. In the past, I used to wash the dishes for lunch and dinner separately. However, when I used the dishwasher, After purchasing it, I have been saving up enough for two meals and running it at once. After dinner, I just throw the dishes in the dishwasher, finish watching Netflix, and when I come out of the shower, I can see the washed dishes shortly - less burden from dishes piling up. Since I can wash pots and dishes without getting my hands wet even if I use them a lot, I don't feel burdened by using new dishes. Since the dishwasher aunt came, there are many cases where all the woks and pans in the house are mobilized. [Cons] - Washing dishes by hand has become a very, very, very annoying thing. In the past, I used to wash the dishes right after eating, but these days, washing dishes by hand is so annoying. Plastic containers, cutting boards, knives, scissors, etc. that cannot be dishwashed must be washed by hand, which is very annoying. I am looking into replacing all of them with dishwasher-safe products. - The washing time is quite long. If you run the regular course, it takes about an hour and a half. On oily days, if you run the soaking + strong wash, it takes more than 2 hours. If you eat dinner early and run it, it does not matter much, but if you eat dinner late, you may wonder what you are doing after running the dishwasher and rubbing your sleepy eyes. - Regrettable drying Drying is done by blowing the wind once to blow away the moisture, and then evaporating the moisture at high temperature. Since it only evaporates the moisture, the drying effect is greatly reduced if water is accumulated. If water is accumulated in the concave area at the bottom of the dish, the moisture in that area remains. Regular drying takes about 5 minutes, and most cups and dishes dry well. However, about 50% are dried well, and half of them have one or two drops of water, so it is difficult to put them in the cupboard right away. If you run the strong dry mode, it will dry for 30 minutes, and 80-90% of the items will be dried well, and only a small amount of laundry will have moisture left. I don't want to bother checking whether it's dry or not, so I use the normal dry mode for drying, and after washing, I put it on a drying tray and let it dry naturally. [Overall] - Buy 30 minutes to 1 hour of free time every day with money - If you're not a single-person household, the dishwasher is an unbeatable 12-person option - It's a good choice if you can overlook some of the shortcomings. Note - If you want to install it under the cooking range, it doesn't matter if you use a gas range, but if you use an induction or highlight, they say there's an additional cost for adding insulation between the dishwasher. - If you tell the installer about the lower cabinet of the sink that was removed during installation, they will collect it for free. - The furniture installer first visits for the installation, disassembling the lower cabinet, wiring, and cutting the hole under the sink. Then, the dishwasher installer comes 1-2 days later. There was no installation fee or delivery fee. If you request a previous installation + reassemble the lower cabinet, it will cost around 100,000 won. It is said that an amount of money of that level is generated

Comments (English): [ A hard-working aunt from 2020 ] || ---------------- || It's been two weeks since I've been with Auntie Dishwasher. During the Lunar New Year holiday, I was cooking various dishes at home and washing dishes when suddenly I got a dishwasher. I went to the department store that day and saw LG and Samsung dishwashers, but both of them cost 1.7 million won. 'I'm the only one who doesn't have a dishwasher. ' I searched Coupang and found a good dishwasher for 700,000 won (with card discount). I thought something was strange and checked the details page, but this product was a 2020 model. The department store was a 2021 model. I asked a department store employee for nearly an hour and asked them carefully. I will start a comparative review between the 2021 model and the 2020 model that I actually used for 2 weeks. The review was written in the order of [Pros], [Cons], and [Overall]. [Pros] - It is cheap. It is about 1 million won cheaper than the 2021 model, but there were three major differences between the two. 1. Addition of a dedicated cutlery tray at the top. The 2020 product was washed by placing the cutlery container in the bottom pot washing compartment, which was a bit disappointing. In the 12-person lower pot tray, excluding the cutlery container, you can put in 1 28cm wok, 1 30cm pan, 1 air fryer inner pot & oil pan, and 1 pan lid. However, if you put in a spoon holder, the size is ambiguous, so you have to take one or two out. The size of the spoon holder is not large, but it is the main reason why the difficulty of Tetris increases rapidly. Also, you have to be careful about where you put the spoons in so that they do not stick to each other in the spoon tray, which is inconvenient. Also, since it is a vertically inserted method, long items such as chopsticks for frying or a spatula get caught on the watering can in the middle and cannot be put in. The 2021 model has a 3-tier tray dedicated to cutlery, so it is convenient because you can just unfold it. 1. Application of water softener filter The 2021 products include a water softener function. Was it LG or Samsung? One company purchased a water softener filter, and the other company only added salt to use it, so the two companies had different forms. However, in places with poor water quality such as Europe or Southeast Asia, a water softener function may be necessary, but is it really necessary in Korea? 3. Without removing the mop holder. For those who live in a rented house, cutting the mop holder can be a problem, but the 2021 model can be installed without cutting the mop holder. The 2020 model must be cut. The three things above were big differences, but in my case, they were shortcomings that I could overlook, so I chose the 2020 model. - Bravo cleaning power I was a distruster of dishwashers, but after actually using it, I found out that it had satisfactory cleaning power. At first, I used to wash it beforehand, but I got lazy and stopped doing that. In particular, I fell in love with the cleaning power when I saw that it completely washed away stubborn grease, such as from air fryer whole pork belly. When I first used it because I was not good at dish Tetris, I was embarrassed because there were some places that weren't cleaned, but after arranging the dishes to match the water nozzle and washing them, they became very clean. - Free time. In the past, I used to wash the dishes for lunch and dinner separately. However, when I used the dishwasher, After purchasing it, I have been saving up enough for two meals and running it at once. After dinner, I just throw the dishes in the dishwasher, finish watching Netflix, and when I come out of the shower, I can see the washed dishes shortly - less burden from dishes piling up. Since I can wash pots and dishes without getting my hands wet even if I use them a lot, I don't feel burdened by using new dishes. Since the dishwasher aunt came, there are many cases where all the woks and pans in the house are mobilized. [Cons] - Washing dishes by hand has become a very, very, very annoying thing. In the past, I used to wash the dishes right after eating, but these days, washing dishes by hand is so annoying. Plastic containers, cutting boards, knives, scissors, etc. that cannot be dishwashed must be washed by hand, which is very annoying. I am looking into replacing all of them with dishwasher-safe products. - The washing time is quite long. If you run the regular course, it takes about an hour and a half. On oily days, if you run the soaking + strong wash, it takes more than 2 hours. If you eat dinner early and run it, it does not matter much, but if you eat dinner late, you may wonder what you are doing after running the dishwasher and rubbing your sleepy eyes. - Regrettable drying Drying is done by blowing the wind once to blow away the moisture, and then evaporating the moisture at high temperature. Since it only evaporates the moisture, the drying effect is greatly reduced if water is accumulated. If water is accumulated in the concave area at the bottom of the dish, the moisture in that area remains. Regular drying takes about 5 minutes, and most cups and dishes dry well. However, about 50% are dried well, and half of them have one or two drops of water, so it is difficult to put them in the cupboard right away. If you run the strong dry mode, it will dry for 30 minutes, and 80-90% of the items will be dried well, and only a small amount of laundry will have moisture left. I don't want to bother checking whether it's dry or not, so I use the normal dry mode for drying, and after washing, I put it on a drying tray and let it dry naturally. [Overall] - Buy 30 minutes to 1 hour of free time every day with money - If you're not a single-person household, the dishwasher is an unbeatable 12-person option - It's a good choice if you can overlook some of the shortcomings. Note - If you want to install it under the cooking range, it doesn't matter if you use a gas range, but if you use an induction or highlight, they say there's an additional cost for adding insulation between the dishwasher. - If you tell the installer about the lower cabinet of the sink that was removed during installation, they will collect it for free. - The furniture installer first visits for the installation, disassembling the lower cabinet, wiring, and cutting the hole under the sink. Then, the dishwasher installer comes 1-2 days later. There was no installation fee or delivery fee. Comments (English): [ A hard-working aunt from 2020 ] || ---------------- || It's been two weeks since I've been with Auntie Dishwasher. During the Lunar New Year holiday, I was cooking various dishes at home and washing dishes when suddenly I got a dishwasher. I went to the department store that day and saw LG and Samsung dishwashers, but both of them cost 1.7 million won. 'I'm the only one who doesn't have a dishwasher. ' I searched Coupang and found a good dishwasher for 700,000 won (with card discount). I thought something was strange and checked the details page, but this product was a 2020 model. The department store was a 2021 model. I asked a department store employee for nearly an hour and asked them carefully. I will start a comparative review between the 2021 model and the 2020 model that I actually used for 2 weeks. The review was written in the order of [Pros], [Cons], and [Overall]. [Pros] - It is cheap. It is about 1 million won cheaper than the 2021 model, but there were three major differences between the two. 1. Addition of a dedicated cutlery tray at the top. The 2020 product was washed by placing the cutlery container in the bottom pot washing compartment, which was a bit disappointing. In the 12-person lower pot tray, excluding the cutlery container, you can put in 1 28cm wok, 1 30cm pan, 1 air fryer inner pot & oil pan, and 1 pan lid. However, if you put in a spoon holder, the size is ambiguous, so you have to take one or two out. The size of the spoon holder is not large, but it is the main reason why the difficulty of Tetris increases rapidly. Also, you have to be careful about where you put the spoons in so that they do not stick to each other in the spoon tray, which is inconvenient. Also, since it is a vertically inserted method, long items such as chopsticks for frying or a spatula get caught on the watering can in the middle and cannot be put in. The 2021 model has a 3-tier tray dedicated to cutlery, so it is convenient because you can just unfold it. 1. Application of water softener filter The 2021 products include a water softener function. Was it LG or Samsung? One company purchased a water softener filter, and the other company only added salt to use it, so the two companies had different forms. However, in places with poor water quality such as Europe or Southeast Asia, a water softener function may be necessary, but is it really necessary in Korea? 3. Without removing the mop holder. For those who live in a rented house, cutting the mop holder can be a problem, but the 2021 model can be installed without cutting the mop holder. The 2020 model must be cut. The three things above were big differences, but in my case, they were shortcomings that I could overlook, so I chose the 2020 model. - Bravo cleaning power I was a distruster of dishwashers, but after actually using it, I found out that it had satisfactory cleaning power. At first, I used to wash it beforehand, but I got lazy and stopped doing that. In particular, I fell in love with the cleaning power when I saw that it completely washed away stubborn grease, such as from air fryer whole pork belly. When I first used it because I was not good at dish Tetris, I was embarrassed because there were some places that weren't cleaned, but after arranging the dishes to match the water nozzle and washing them, they became very clean. - Free time. In the past, I used to wash the dishes for lunch and dinner separately. However, when I used the dishwasher, After purchasing it, I have been saving up enough for two meals and running it at once. After dinner, I just throw the dishes in the dishwasher, finish watching Netflix, and when I come out of the shower, I can see the washed dishes shortly - less burden from dishes piling up. Since I can wash pots and dishes without getting my hands wet even if I use them a lot, I don't feel burdened by using new dishes. Since the dishwasher aunt came, there are many cases where all the woks and pans in the house are mobilized. [Cons] - Washing dishes by hand has become a very, very, very annoying thing. In the past, I used to wash the dishes right after eating, but these days, washing dishes by hand is so annoying. Plastic containers, cutting boards, knives, scissors, etc. that cannot be dishwashed must be washed by hand, which is very annoying. I am looking into replacing all of them with dishwasher-safe products. - The washing time is quite long. If you run the regular course, it takes about an hour and a half. On oily days, if you run the soaking + strong wash, it takes more than 2 hours. If you eat dinner early and run it, it does not matter much, but if you eat dinner late, you may wonder what you are doing after running the dishwasher and rubbing your sleepy eyes. - Regrettable drying Drying is done by blowing the wind once to blow away the moisture, and then evaporating the moisture at high temperature. Since it only evaporates the moisture, the drying effect is greatly reduced if water is accumulated. If water is accumulated in the concave area at the bottom of the dish, the moisture in that area remains. Regular drying takes about 5 minutes, and most cups and dishes dry well. However, about 50% are dried well, and half of them have one or two drops of water, so it is difficult to put them in the cupboard right away. If you run the strong dry mode, it will dry for 30 minutes, and 80-90% of the items will be dried well, and only a small amount of laundry will have moisture left. I don't want to bother checking whether it's dry or not, so I use the normal dry mode for drying, and after washing, I put it on a drying tray and let it dry naturally. [Overall] - Buy 30 minutes to 1 hour of free time every day with money - If you're not a single-person household, the dishwasher is an unbeatable 12-person option - It's a good choice if you can overlook some of the shortcomings. Note - If you want to install it under the cooking range, it doesn't matter if you use a gas range, but if you use an induction or highlight, they say there's an additional cost for adding insulation between the dishwasher. - If you tell the installer about the lower cabinet of the sink that was removed during installation, they will collect it for free. - The furniture installer first visits for the installation, disassembling the lower cabinet, wiring, and cutting the hole under the sink. Then, the dishwasher installer comes 1-2 days later. There was no installation fee or delivery fee.
