Comments (English): [ A hard-working aunt from 2020 ] || ---------------- || It's been two weeks since I've been with Auntie Dishwasher. During the Lunar New Year holiday, I was cooking various dishes at home and washing dishes when suddenly I got a dishwasher. I went to the department store that day and saw LG and Samsung dishwashers, but both of them cost 1.7 million won. 'I'm the only one who doesn't have a dishwasher. ' I searched Coupang and found a good dishwasher for 700,000 won (with card discount). I thought something was strange and checked the details page, but this product was a 2020 model. The department store was a 2021 model. I asked a department store employee for nearly an hour and asked them carefully. I will start a comparative review between the 2021 model and the 2020 model that I actually used for 2 weeks. The review was written in the order of [Pros], [Cons], and [Overall]. [Pros] - It is cheap. It is about 1 million won cheaper than the 2021 model, but there were three major differences between the two. 1. Addition of a dedicated cutlery tray at the top. The 2020 product was washed by placing the cutlery container in the bottom pot washing compartment, which was a bit disappointing. In the 12-person lower pot tray, excluding the cutlery container, you can put in 1 28cm wok, 1 30cm pan, 1 air fryer inner pot & oil pan, and 1 pan lid. However, if you put in a spoon holder, the size is ambiguous, so you have to take one or two out. The size of the spoon holder is not large, but it is the main reason why the difficulty of Tetris increases rapidly. Also, you have to be careful about where you put the spoons in so that they do not stick to each other in the spoon tray, which is inconvenient. Also, since it is a vertically inserted method, long items such as chopsticks for frying or a spatula get caught on the watering can in the middle and cannot be put in. The 2021 model has a 3-tier tray dedicated to cutlery, so it is convenient because you can just unfold it. 1. Application of water softener filter The 2021 products include a water softener function. Was it LG or Samsung? One company purchased a water softener filter, and the other company only added salt to use it, so the two companies had different forms. However, in places with poor water quality such as Europe or Southeast Asia, a water softener function may be necessary, but is it really necessary in Korea? 3. Without removing the mop holder. For those who live in a rented house, cutting the mop holder can be a problem, but the 2021 model can be installed without cutting the mop holder. The 2020 model must be cut. The three things above were big differences, but in my case, they were shortcomings that I could overlook, so I chose the 2020 model. - Bravo cleaning power I was a distruster of dishwashers, but after actually using it, I found out that it had satisfactory cleaning power. At first, I used to wash it beforehand, but I got lazy and stopped doing that. In particular, I fell in love with the cleaning power when I saw that it completely washed away stubborn grease, such as from air fryer whole pork belly. When I first used it because I was not good at dish Tetris, I was embarrassed because there were some places that weren't cleaned, but after arranging the dishes to match the water nozzle and washing them, they became very clean. - Free time. In the past, I used to wash the dishes for lunch and dinner separately. However, when I used the dishwasher, After purchasing it, I have been saving up enough for two meals and running it at once. After dinner, I just throw the dishes in the dishwasher, finish watching Netflix, and when I come out of the shower, I can see the washed dishes shortly - less burden from dishes piling up. Since I can wash pots and dishes without getting my hands wet even if I use them a lot, I don't feel burdened by using new dishes. Since the dishwasher aunt came, there are many cases where all the woks and pans in the house are mobilized. [Cons] - Washing dishes by hand has become a very, very, very annoying thing. In the past, I used to wash the dishes right after eating, but these days, washing dishes by hand is so annoying. Plastic containers, cutting boards, knives, scissors, etc. that cannot be dishwashed must be washed by hand, which is very annoying. I am looking into replacing all of them with dishwasher-safe products. - The washing time is quite long. If you run the regular course, it takes about an hour and a half. On oily days, if you run the soaking + strong wash, it takes more than 2 hours. If you eat dinner early and run it, it does not matter much, but if you eat dinner late, you may wonder what you are doing after running the dishwasher and rubbing your sleepy eyes. - Regrettable drying Drying is done by blowing the wind once to blow away the moisture, and then evaporating the moisture at high temperature. Since it only evaporates the moisture, the drying effect is greatly reduced if water is accumulated. If water is accumulated in the concave area at the bottom of the dish, the moisture in that area remains. Regular drying takes about 5 minutes, and most cups and dishes dry well. However, about 50% are dried well, and half of them have one or two drops of water, so it is difficult to put them in the cupboard right away. If you run the strong dry mode, it will dry for 30 minutes, and 80-90% of the items will be dried well, and only a small amount of laundry will have moisture left. I don't want to bother checking whether it's dry or not, so I use the normal dry mode for drying, and after washing, I put it on a drying tray and let it dry naturally. [Overall] - Buy 30 minutes to 1 hour of free time every day with money - If you're not a single-person household, the dishwasher is an unbeatable 12-person option - It's a good choice if you can overlook some of the shortcomings. Note - If you want to install it under the cooking range, it doesn't matter if you use a gas range, but if you use an induction or highlight, they say there's an additional cost for adding insulation between the dishwasher. - If you tell the installer about the lower cabinet of the sink that was removed during installation, they will collect it for free. - The furniture installer first visits for the installation, disassembling the lower cabinet, wiring, and cutting the hole under the sink. Then, the dishwasher installer comes 1-2 days later. There was no installation fee or delivery fee. Comments (English): [ A hard-working aunt from 2020 ] || ---------------- || It's been two weeks since I've been with Auntie Dishwasher. During the Lunar New Year holiday, I was cooking various dishes at home and washing dishes when suddenly I got a dishwasher. I went to the department store that day and saw LG and Samsung dishwashers, but both of them cost 1.7 million won. 'I'm the only one who doesn't have a dishwasher. ' I searched Coupang and found a good dishwasher for 700,000 won (with card discount). I thought something was strange and checked the details page, but this product was a 2020 model. The department store was a 2021 model. I asked a department store employee for nearly an hour and asked them carefully. I will start a comparative review between the 2021 model and the 2020 model that I actually used for 2 weeks. The review was written in the order of [Pros], [Cons], and [Overall]. [Pros] - It is cheap. It is about 1 million won cheaper than the 2021 model, but there were three major differences between the two. 1. Addition of a dedicated cutlery tray at the top. The 2020 product was washed by placing the cutlery container in the bottom pot washing compartment, which was a bit disappointing. In the 12-person lower pot tray, excluding the cutlery container, you can put in 1 28cm wok, 1 30cm pan, 1 air fryer inner pot & oil pan, and 1 pan lid. However, if you put in a spoon holder, the size is ambiguous, so you have to take one or two out. The size of the spoon holder is not large, but it is the main reason why the difficulty of Tetris increases rapidly. Also, you have to be careful about where you put the spoons in so that they do not stick to each other in the spoon tray, which is inconvenient. Also, since it is a vertically inserted method, long items such as chopsticks for frying or a spatula get caught on the watering can in the middle and cannot be put in. The 2021 model has a 3-tier tray dedicated to cutlery, so it is convenient because you can just unfold it. 1. Application of water softener filter The 2021 products include a water softener function. Was it LG or Samsung? One company purchased a water softener filter, and the other company only added salt to use it, so the two companies had different forms. However, in places with poor water quality such as Europe or Southeast Asia, a water softener function may be necessary, but is it really necessary in Korea? 3. Without removing the mop holder. For those who live in a rented house, cutting the mop holder can be a problem, but the 2021 model can be installed without cutting the mop holder. The 2020 model must be cut. The three things above were big differences, but in my case, they were shortcomings that I could overlook, so I chose the 2020 model. - Bravo cleaning power I was a distruster of dishwashers, but after actually using it, I found out that it had satisfactory cleaning power. At first, I used to wash it beforehand, but I got lazy and stopped doing that. In particular, I fell in love with the cleaning power when I saw that it completely washed away stubborn grease, such as from air fryer whole pork belly. When I first used it because I was not good at dish Tetris, I was embarrassed because there were some places that weren't cleaned, but after arranging the dishes to match the water nozzle and washing them, they became very clean. - Free time. In the past, I used to wash the dishes for lunch and dinner separately. However, when I used the dishwasher, After purchasing it, I have been saving up enough for two meals and running it at once. After dinner, I just throw the dishes in the dishwasher, finish watching Netflix, and when I come out of the shower, I can see the washed dishes shortly - less burden from dishes piling up. Since I can wash pots and dishes without getting my hands wet even if I use them a lot, I don't feel burdened by using new dishes. Since the dishwasher aunt came, there are many cases where all the woks and pans in the house are mobilized. [Cons] - Washing dishes by hand has become a very, very, very annoying thing. In the past, I used to wash the dishes right after eating, but these days, washing dishes by hand is so annoying. Plastic containers, cutting boards, knives, scissors, etc. that cannot be dishwashed must be washed by hand, which is very annoying. I am looking into replacing all of them with dishwasher-safe products. - The washing time is quite long. If you run the regular course, it takes about an hour and a half. On oily days, if you run the soaking + strong wash, it takes more than 2 hours. If you eat dinner early and run it, it does not matter much, but if you eat dinner late, you may wonder what you are doing after running the dishwasher and rubbing your sleepy eyes. - Regrettable drying Drying is done by blowing the wind once to blow away the moisture, and then evaporating the moisture at high temperature. Since it only evaporates the moisture, the drying effect is greatly reduced if water is accumulated. If water is accumulated in the concave area at the bottom of the dish, the moisture in that area remains. Regular drying takes about 5 minutes, and most cups and dishes dry well. However, about 50% are dried well, and half of them have one or two drops of water, so it is difficult to put them in the cupboard right away. If you run the strong dry mode, it will dry for 30 minutes, and 80-90% of the items will be dried well, and only a small amount of laundry will have moisture left. I don't want to bother checking whether it's dry or not, so I use the normal dry mode for drying, and after washing, I put it on a drying tray and let it dry naturally. [Overall] - Buy 30 minutes to 1 hour of free time every day with money - If you're not a single-person household, the dishwasher is an unbeatable 12-person option - It's a good choice if you can overlook some of the shortcomings. Note - If you want to install it under the cooking range, it doesn't matter if you use a gas range, but if you use an induction or highlight, they say there's an additional cost for adding insulation between the dishwasher. - If you tell the installer about the lower cabinet of the sink that was removed during installation, they will collect it for free. - The furniture installer first visits for the installation, disassembling the lower cabinet, wiring, and cutting the hole under the sink. Then, the dishwasher installer comes 1-2 days later. There was no installation fee or delivery fee. Comments (English): [ A hard-working aunt from 2020 ] || ---------------- || It's been two weeks since I've been with Auntie Dishwasher. During the Lunar New Year holiday, I was cooking various dishes at home and washing dishes when suddenly I got a dishwasher. I went to the department store that day and saw LG and Samsung dishwashers, but both of them cost 1.7 million won. 'I'm the only one who doesn't have a dishwasher. ' I searched Coupang and found a good dishwasher for 700,000 won (with card discount). I thought something was strange and checked the details page, but this product was a 2020 model. The department store was a 2021 model. I asked a department store employee for nearly an hour and asked them carefully. I will start a comparative review between the 2021 model and the 2020 model that I actually used for 2 weeks. The review was written in the order of [Pros], [Cons], and [Overall]. [Pros] - It is cheap. It is about 1 million won cheaper than the 2021 model, but there were three major differences between the two. 1. Addition of a dedicated cutlery tray at the top. The 2020 product was washed by placing the cutlery container in the bottom pot washing compartment, which was a bit disappointing. In the 12-person lower pot tray, excluding the cutlery container, you can put in 1 28cm wok, 1 30cm pan, 1 air fryer inner pot & oil pan, and 1 pan lid. However, if you put in a spoon holder, the size is ambiguous, so you have to take one or two out. The size of the spoon holder is not large, but it is the main reason why the difficulty of Tetris increases rapidly. Also, you have to be careful about where you put the spoons in so that they do not stick to each other in the spoon tray, which is inconvenient. Also, since it is a vertically inserted method, long items such as chopsticks for frying or a spatula get caught on the watering can in the middle and cannot be put in. The 2021 model has a 3-tier tray dedicated to cutlery, so it is convenient because you can just unfold it. 1. Application of water softener filter The 2021 products include a water softener function. Was it LG or Samsung? One company purchased a water softener filter, and the other company only added salt to use it, so the two companies had different forms. However, in places with poor water quality such as Europe or Southeast Asia, a water softener function may be necessary, but is it really necessary in Korea? 3. Without removing the mop holder. For those who live in a rented house, cutting the mop holder can be a problem, but the 2021 model can be installed without cutting the mop holder. The 2020 model must be cut. The three things above were big differences, but in my case, they were shortcomings that I could overlook, so I chose the 2020 model. - Bravo cleaning power I was a distruster of dishwashers, but after actually using it, I found out that it had satisfactory cleaning power. At first, I used to wash it beforehand, but I got lazy and stopped doing that. In particular, I fell in love with the cleaning power when I saw that it completely washed away stubborn grease, such as from air fryer whole pork belly. When I first used it because I was not good at dish Tetris, I was embarrassed because there were some places that weren't cleaned, but after arranging the dishes to match the water nozzle and washing them, they became very clean. - Free time. In the past, I used to wash the dishes for lunch and dinner separately. However, when I used the dishwasher, After purchasing it, I have been saving up enough for two meals and running it at once. After dinner, I just throw the dishes in the dishwasher, finish watching Netflix, and when I come out of the shower, I can see the washed dishes shortly - less burden from dishes piling up. Since I can wash pots and dishes without getting my hands wet even if I use them a lot, I don't feel burdened by using new dishes. Since the dishwasher aunt came, there are many cases where all the woks and pans in the house are mobilized. [Cons] - Washing dishes by hand has become a very, very, very annoying thing. In the past, I used to wash the dishes right after eating, but these days, washing dishes by hand is so annoying. Plastic containers, cutting boards, knives, scissors, etc. that cannot be dishwashed must be washed by hand, which is very annoying. I am looking into replacing all of them with dishwasher-safe products. - The washing time is quite long. If you run the regular course, it takes about an hour and a half. On oily days, if you run the soaking + strong wash, it takes more than 2 hours. If you eat dinner early and run it, it does not matter much, but if you eat dinner late, you may wonder what you are doing after running the dishwasher and rubbing your sleepy eyes. - Regrettable drying Drying is done by blowing the wind once to blow away the moisture, and then evaporating the moisture at high temperature. Since it only evaporates the moisture, the drying effect is greatly reduced if water is accumulated. If water is accumulated in the concave area at the bottom of the dish, the moisture in that area remains. Regular drying takes about 5 minutes, and most cups and dishes dry well. However, about 50% are dried well, and half of them have one or two drops of water, so it is difficult to put them in the cupboard right away. If you run the strong dry mode, it will dry for 30 minutes, and 80-90% of the items will be dried well, and only a small amount of laundry will have moisture left. I don't want to bother checking whether it's dry or not, so I use the normal dry mode for drying, and after washing, I put it on a drying tray and let it dry naturally. [Overall] - Buy 30 minutes to 1 hour of free time every day with money - If you're not a single-person household, the dishwasher is an unbeatable 12-person option - It's a good choice if you can overlook some of the shortcomings. Note - If you want to install it under the cooking range, it doesn't matter if you use a gas range, but if you use an induction or highlight, they say there's an additional cost for adding insulation between the dishwasher. - If you tell the installer about the lower cabinet of the sink that was removed during installation, they will collect it for free. - The furniture installer first visits for the installation, disassembling the lower cabinet, wiring, and cutting the hole under the sink. Then, the dishwasher installer comes 1-2 days later. There was no installation fee or delivery fee. Sentence (English): In the past, I used to wash the dishes right after eating, but these days, washing dishes by hand is so annoying.
Comments (English): [ A hard-working aunt from 2020 ] || ---------------- || It's been two weeks since I've been with Auntie Dishwasher. During the Lunar New Year holiday, I was cooking various dishes at home and washing dishes when suddenly I got a dishwasher. I went to the department store that day and saw LG and Samsung dishwashers, but both of them cost 1.7 million won. 'I'm the only one who doesn't have a dishwasher. ' I searched Coupang and found a good dishwasher for 700,000 won (with card discount). I thought something was strange and checked the details page, but this product was a 2020 model. The department store was a 2021 model. I asked a department store employee for nearly an hour and asked them carefully. I will start a comparative review between the 2021 model and the 2020 model that I actually used for 2 weeks. The review was written in the order of [Pros], [Cons], and [Overall]. [Pros] - It is cheap. It is about 1 million won cheaper than the 2021 model, but there were three major differences between the two. 1. Addition of a dedicated cutlery tray at the top. The 2020 product was washed by placing the cutlery container in the bottom pot washing compartment, which was a bit disappointing. In the 12-person lower pot tray, excluding the cutlery container, you can put in 1 28cm wok, 1 30cm pan, 1 air fryer inner pot & oil pan, and 1 pan lid. However, if you put in a spoon holder, the size is ambiguous, so you have to take one or two out. The size of the spoon holder is not large, but it is the main reason why the difficulty of Tetris increases rapidly. Also, you have to be careful about where you put the spoons in so that they do not stick to each other in the spoon tray, which is inconvenient. Also, since it is a vertically inserted method, long items such as chopsticks for frying or a spatula get caught on the watering can in the middle and cannot be put in. The 2021 model has a 3-tier tray dedicated to cutlery, so it is convenient because you can just unfold it. 1. Application of water softener filter The 2021 products include a water softener function. Was it LG or Samsung? One company purchased a water softener filter, and the other company only added salt to use it, so the two companies had different forms. However, in places with poor water quality such as Europe or Southeast Asia, a water softener function may be necessary, but is it really necessary in Korea? 3. Without removing the mop holder. For those who live in a rented house, cutting the mop holder can be a problem, but the 2021 model can be installed without cutting the mop holder. The 2020 model must be cut. The three things above were big differences, but in my case, they were shortcomings that I could overlook, so I chose the 2020 model. - Bravo cleaning power I was a distruster of dishwashers, but after actually using it, I found out that it had satisfactory cleaning power. At first, I used to wash it beforehand, but I got lazy and stopped doing that. In particular, I fell in love with the cleaning power when I saw that it completely washed away stubborn grease, such as from air fryer whole pork belly. When I first used it because I was not good at dish Tetris, I was embarrassed because there were some places that weren't cleaned, but after arranging the dishes to match the water nozzle and washing them, they became very clean. - Free time. In the past, I used to wash the dishes for lunch and dinner separately. However, when I used the dishwasher, After purchasing it, I have been saving up enough for two meals and running it at once. After dinner, I just throw the dishes in the dishwasher, finish watching Netflix, and when I come out of the shower, I can see the washed dishes shortly - less burden from dishes piling up. Since I can wash pots and dishes without getting my hands wet even if I use them a lot, I don't feel burdened by using new dishes. Since the dishwasher aunt came, there are many cases where all the woks and pans in the house are mobilized. [Cons] - Washing dishes by hand has become a very, very, very annoying thing. In the past, I used to wash the dishes right after eating, but these days, washing dishes by hand is so annoying. Plastic containers, cutting boards, knives, scissors, etc. that cannot be dishwashed must be washed by hand, which is very annoying. I am looking into replacing all of them with dishwasher-safe products. - The washing time is quite long. If you run the regular course, it takes about an hour and a half. On oily days, if you run the soaking + strong wash, it takes more than 2 hours. If you eat dinner early and run it, it does not matter much, but if you eat dinner late, you may wonder what you are doing after running the dishwasher and rubbing your sleepy eyes. - Regrettable drying Drying is done by blowing the wind once to blow away the moisture, and then evaporating the moisture at high temperature. Since it only evaporates the moisture, the drying effect is greatly reduced if water is accumulated. If water is accumulated in the concave area at the bottom of the dish, the moisture in that area remains. Regular drying takes about 5 minutes, and most cups and dishes dry well. However, about 50% are dried well, and half of them have one or two drops of water, so it is difficult to put them in the cupboard right away. If you run the strong dry mode, it will dry for 30 minutes, and 80-90% of the items will be dried well, and only a small amount of laundry will have moisture left. I don't want to bother checking whether it's dry or not, so I use the normal dry mode for drying, and after washing, I put it on a drying tray and let it dry naturally. [Overall] - Buy 30 minutes to 1 hour of free time every day with money - If you're not a single-person household, the dishwasher is an unbeatable 12-person option - It's a good choice if you can overlook some of the shortcomings. Note - If you want to install it under the cooking range, it doesn't matter if you use a gas range, but if you use an induction or highlight, they say there's an additional cost for adding insulation between the dishwasher. - If you tell the installer about the lower cabinet of the sink that was removed during installation, they will collect it for free. - The furniture installer first visits for the installation, disassembling the lower cabinet, wiring, and cutting the hole under the sink. Then, the dishwasher installer comes 1-2 days later. There was no installation fee or delivery fee. If you request a previous installation + reassemble the lower cabinet, it will cost around 100,000 won. It is said that an amount of money of that level is generated

Sentence (English): In the past, I used to wash the dishes right after eating, but these days, washing dishes by hand is so annoying.
Comments (English): [ A hard-working aunt from 2020 ] || ---------------- || It's been two weeks since I've been with Auntie Dishwasher. During the Lunar New Year holiday, I was cooking various dishes at home and washing dishes when suddenly I got a dishwasher. I went to the department store that day and saw LG and Samsung dishwashers, but both of them cost 1.7 million won. 'I'm the only one who doesn't have a dishwasher. ' I searched Coupang and found a good dishwasher for 700,000 won (with card discount). I thought something was strange and checked the details page, but this product was a 2020 model. The department store was a 2021 model. I asked a department store employee for nearly an hour and asked them carefully. I will start a comparative review between the 2021 model and the 2020 model that I actually used for 2 weeks. The review was written in the order of [Pros], [Cons], and [Overall]. [Pros] - It is cheap. It is about 1 million won cheaper than the 2021 model, but there were three major differences between the two. 1. Addition of a dedicated cutlery tray at the top. The 2020 product was washed by placing the cutlery container in the bottom pot washing compartment, which was a bit disappointing. In the 12-person lower pot tray, excluding the cutlery container, you can put in 1 28cm wok, 1 30cm pan, 1 air fryer inner pot & oil pan, and 1 pan lid. However, if you put in a spoon holder, the size is ambiguous, so you have to take one or two out. The size of the spoon holder is not large, but it is the main reason why the difficulty of Tetris increases rapidly. Also, you have to be careful about where you put the spoons in so that they do not stick to each other in the spoon tray, which is inconvenient. Also, since it is a vertically inserted method, long items such as chopsticks for frying or a spatula get caught on the watering can in the middle and cannot be put in. The 2021 model has a 3-tier tray dedicated to cutlery, so it is convenient because you can just unfold it. 1. Application of water softener filter The 2021 products include a water softener function. Was it LG or Samsung? One company purchased a water softener filter, and the other company only added salt to use it, so the two companies had different forms. However, in places with poor water quality such as Europe or Southeast Asia, a water softener function may be necessary, but is it really necessary in Korea? 3. Without removing the mop holder. For those who live in a rented house, cutting the mop holder can be a problem, but the 2021 model can be installed without cutting the mop holder. The 2020 model must be cut. The three things above were big differences, but in my case, they were shortcomings that I could overlook, so I chose the 2020 model. - Bravo cleaning power I was a distruster of dishwashers, but after actually using it, I found out that it had satisfactory cleaning power. At first, I used to wash it beforehand, but I got lazy and stopped doing that. In particular, I fell in love with the cleaning power when I saw that it completely washed away stubborn grease, such as from air fryer whole pork belly. When I first used it because I was not good at dish Tetris, I was embarrassed because there were some places that weren't cleaned, but after arranging the dishes to match the water nozzle and washing them, they became very clean. - Free time. In the past, I used to wash the dishes for lunch and dinner separately. However, when I used the dishwasher, After purchasing it, I have been saving up enough for two meals and running it at once. After dinner, I just throw the dishes in the dishwasher, finish watching Netflix, and when I come out of the shower, I can see the washed dishes shortly - less burden from dishes piling up. Since I can wash pots and dishes without getting my hands wet even if I use them a lot, I don't feel burdened by using new dishes. Since the dishwasher aunt came, there are many cases where all the woks and pans in the house are mobilized. [Cons] - Washing dishes by hand has become a very, very, very annoying thing. In the past, I used to wash the dishes right after eating, but these days, washing dishes by hand is so annoying. Plastic containers, cutting boards, knives, scissors, etc. that cannot be dishwashed must be washed by hand, which is very annoying. I am looking into replacing all of them with dishwasher-safe products. - The washing time is quite long. If you run the regular course, it takes about an hour and a half. On oily days, if you run the soaking + strong wash, it takes more than 2 hours. If you eat dinner early and run it, it does not matter much, but if you eat dinner late, you may wonder what you are doing after running the dishwasher and rubbing your sleepy eyes. - Regrettable drying Drying is done by blowing the wind once to blow away the moisture, and then evaporating the moisture at high temperature. Since it only evaporates the moisture, the drying effect is greatly reduced if water is accumulated. If water is accumulated in the concave area at the bottom of the dish, the moisture in that area remains. Regular drying takes about 5 minutes, and most cups and dishes dry well. However, about 50% are dried well, and half of them have one or two drops of water, so it is difficult to put them in the cupboard right away. If you run the strong dry mode, it will dry for 30 minutes, and 80-90% of the items will be dried well, and only a small amount of laundry will have moisture left. I don't want to bother checking whether it's dry or not, so I use the normal dry mode for drying, and after washing, I put it on a drying tray and let it dry naturally. [Overall] - Buy 30 minutes to 1 hour of free time every day with money - If you're not a single-person household, the dishwasher is an unbeatable 12-person option - It's a good choice if you can overlook some of the shortcomings. Note - If you want to install it under the cooking range, it doesn't matter if you use a gas range, but if you use an induction or highlight, they say there's an additional cost for adding insulation between the dishwasher. - If you tell the installer about the lower cabinet of the sink that was removed during installation, they will collect it for free. - The furniture installer first visits for the installation, disassembling the lower cabinet, wiring, and cutting the hole under the sink. Then, the dishwasher installer comes 1-2 days later. There was no installation fee or delivery fee. If you request a previous installation + reassemble the lower cabinet, it will cost around 100,000 won. It is said that an amount of money of that level is generated

Comments (English): [ A hard-working aunt from 2020 ] || ---------------- || It's been two weeks since I've been with Auntie Dishwasher. During the Lunar New Year holiday, I was cooking various dishes at home and washing dishes when suddenly I got a dishwasher. I went to the department store that day and saw LG and Samsung dishwashers, but both of them cost 1.7 million won. 'I'm the only one who doesn't have a dishwasher. ' I searched Coupang and found a good dishwasher for 700,000 won (with card discount). I thought something was strange and checked the details page, but this product was a 2020 model. The department store was a 2021 model. I asked a department store employee for nearly an hour and asked them carefully. I will start a comparative review between the 2021 model and the 2020 model that I actually used for 2 weeks. The review was written in the order of [Pros], [Cons], and [Overall]. [Pros] - It is cheap. It is about 1 million won cheaper than the 2021 model, but there were three major differences between the two. 1. Addition of a dedicated cutlery tray at the top. The 2020 product was washed by placing the cutlery container in the bottom pot washing compartment, which was a bit disappointing. In the 12-person lower pot tray, excluding the cutlery container, you can put in 1 28cm wok, 1 30cm pan, 1 air fryer inner pot & oil pan, and 1 pan lid. However, if you put in a spoon holder, the size is ambiguous, so you have to take one or two out. The size of the spoon holder is not large, but it is the main reason why the difficulty of Tetris increases rapidly. Also, you have to be careful about where you put the spoons in so that they do not stick to each other in the spoon tray, which is inconvenient. Also, since it is a vertically inserted method, long items such as chopsticks for frying or a spatula get caught on the watering can in the middle and cannot be put in. The 2021 model has a 3-tier tray dedicated to cutlery, so it is convenient because you can just unfold it. 1. Application of water softener filter The 2021 products include a water softener function. Was it LG or Samsung? One company purchased a water softener filter, and the other company only added salt to use it, so the two companies had different forms. However, in places with poor water quality such as Europe or Southeast Asia, a water softener function may be necessary, but is it really necessary in Korea? 3. Without removing the mop holder. For those who live in a rented house, cutting the mop holder can be a problem, but the 2021 model can be installed without cutting the mop holder. The 2020 model must be cut. The three things above were big differences, but in my case, they were shortcomings that I could overlook, so I chose the 2020 model. - Bravo cleaning power I was a distruster of dishwashers, but after actually using it, I found out that it had satisfactory cleaning power. At first, I used to wash it beforehand, but I got lazy and stopped doing that. In particular, I fell in love with the cleaning power when I saw that it completely washed away stubborn grease, such as from air fryer whole pork belly. When I first used it because I was not good at dish Tetris, I was embarrassed because there were some places that weren't cleaned, but after arranging the dishes to match the water nozzle and washing them, they became very clean. - Free time. In the past, I used to wash the dishes for lunch and dinner separately. However, when I used the dishwasher, After purchasing it, I have been saving up enough for two meals and running it at once. After dinner, I just throw the dishes in the dishwasher, finish watching Netflix, and when I come out of the shower, I can see the washed dishes shortly - less burden from dishes piling up. Since I can wash pots and dishes without getting my hands wet even if I use them a lot, I don't feel burdened by using new dishes. Since the dishwasher aunt came, there are many cases where all the woks and pans in the house are mobilized. [Cons] - Washing dishes by hand has become a very, very, very annoying thing. In the past, I used to wash the dishes right after eating, but these days, washing dishes by hand is so annoying. Plastic containers, cutting boards, knives, scissors, etc. that cannot be dishwashed must be washed by hand, which is very annoying. I am looking into replacing all of them with dishwasher-safe products. - The washing time is quite long. If you run the regular course, it takes about an hour and a half. On oily days, if you run the soaking + strong wash, it takes more than 2 hours. If you eat dinner early and run it, it does not matter much, but if you eat dinner late, you may wonder what you are doing after running the dishwasher and rubbing your sleepy eyes. - Regrettable drying Drying is done by blowing the wind once to blow away the moisture, and then evaporating the moisture at high temperature. Since it only evaporates the moisture, the drying effect is greatly reduced if water is accumulated. If water is accumulated in the concave area at the bottom of the dish, the moisture in that area remains. Regular drying takes about 5 minutes, and most cups and dishes dry well. However, about 50% are dried well, and half of them have one or two drops of water, so it is difficult to put them in the cupboard right away. If you run the strong dry mode, it will dry for 30 minutes, and 80-90% of the items will be dried well, and only a small amount of laundry will have moisture left. I don't want to bother checking whether it's dry or not, so I use the normal dry mode for drying, and after washing, I put it on a drying tray and let it dry naturally. [Overall] - Buy 30 minutes to 1 hour of free time every day with money - If you're not a single-person household, the dishwasher is an unbeatable 12-person option - It's a good choice if you can overlook some of the shortcomings. Note - If you want to install it under the cooking range, it doesn't matter if you use a gas range, but if you use an induction or highlight, they say there's an additional cost for adding insulation between the dishwasher. - If you tell the installer about the lower cabinet of the sink that was removed during installation, they will collect it for free. - The furniture installer first visits for the installation, disassembling the lower cabinet, wiring, and cutting the hole under the sink. Then, the dishwasher installer comes 1-2 days later. There was no installation fee or delivery fee. Comments (English): [ A hard-working aunt from 2020 ] || ---------------- || It's been two weeks since I've been with Auntie Dishwasher. During the Lunar New Year holiday, I was cooking various dishes at home and washing dishes when suddenly I got a dishwasher. I went to the department store that day and saw LG and Samsung dishwashers, but both of them cost 1.7 million won. 'I'm the only one who doesn't have a dishwasher. ' I searched Coupang and found a good dishwasher for 700,000 won (with card discount). I thought something was strange and checked the details page, but this product was a 2020 model. The department store was a 2021 model. I asked a department store employee for nearly an hour and asked them carefully. I will start a comparative review between the 2021 model and the 2020 model that I actually used for 2 weeks. The review was written in the order of [Pros], [Cons], and [Overall]. [Pros] - It is cheap. It is about 1 million won cheaper than the 2021 model, but there were three major differences between the two. 1. Addition of a dedicated cutlery tray at the top. The 2020 product was washed by placing the cutlery container in the bottom pot washing compartment, which was a bit disappointing. In the 12-person lower pot tray, excluding the cutlery container, you can put in 1 28cm wok, 1 30cm pan, 1 air fryer inner pot & oil pan, and 1 pan lid. However, if you put in a spoon holder, the size is ambiguous, so you have to take one or two out. The size of the spoon holder is not large, but it is the main reason why the difficulty of Tetris increases rapidly. Also, you have to be careful about where you put the spoons in so that they do not stick to each other in the spoon tray, which is inconvenient. Also, since it is a vertically inserted method, long items such as chopsticks for frying or a spatula get caught on the watering can in the middle and cannot be put in. The 2021 model has a 3-tier tray dedicated to cutlery, so it is convenient because you can just unfold it. 1. Application of water softener filter The 2021 products include a water softener function. Was it LG or Samsung? One company purchased a water softener filter, and the other company only added salt to use it, so the two companies had different forms. However, in places with poor water quality such as Europe or Southeast Asia, a water softener function may be necessary, but is it really necessary in Korea? 3. Without removing the mop holder. For those who live in a rented house, cutting the mop holder can be a problem, but the 2021 model can be installed without cutting the mop holder. The 2020 model must be cut. The three things above were big differences, but in my case, they were shortcomings that I could overlook, so I chose the 2020 model. - Bravo cleaning power I was a distruster of dishwashers, but after actually using it, I found out that it had satisfactory cleaning power. At first, I used to wash it beforehand, but I got lazy and stopped doing that. In particular, I fell in love with the cleaning power when I saw that it completely washed away stubborn grease, such as from air fryer whole pork belly. When I first used it because I was not good at dish Tetris, I was embarrassed because there were some places that weren't cleaned, but after arranging the dishes to match the water nozzle and washing them, they became very clean. - Free time. In the past, I used to wash the dishes for lunch and dinner separately. However, when I used the dishwasher, After purchasing it, I have been saving up enough for two meals and running it at once. After dinner, I just throw the dishes in the dishwasher, finish watching Netflix, and when I come out of the shower, I can see the washed dishes shortly - less burden from dishes piling up. Since I can wash pots and dishes without getting my hands wet even if I use them a lot, I don't feel burdened by using new dishes. Since the dishwasher aunt came, there are many cases where all the woks and pans in the house are mobilized. [Cons] - Washing dishes by hand has become a very, very, very annoying thing. In the past, I used to wash the dishes right after eating, but these days, washing dishes by hand is so annoying. Plastic containers, cutting boards, knives, scissors, etc. that cannot be dishwashed must be washed by hand, which is very annoying. I am looking into replacing all of them with dishwasher-safe products. - The washing time is quite long. If you run the regular course, it takes about an hour and a half. On oily days, if you run the soaking + strong wash, it takes more than 2 hours. If you eat dinner early and run it, it does not matter much, but if you eat dinner late, you may wonder what you are doing after running the dishwasher and rubbing your sleepy eyes. - Regrettable drying Drying is done by blowing the wind once to blow away the moisture, and then evaporating the moisture at high temperature. Since it only evaporates the moisture, the drying effect is greatly reduced if water is accumulated. If water is accumulated in the concave area at the bottom of the dish, the moisture in that area remains. Regular drying takes about 5 minutes, and most cups and dishes dry well. However, about 50% are dried well, and half of them have one or two drops of water, so it is difficult to put them in the cupboard right away. If you run the strong dry mode, it will dry for 30 minutes, and 80-90% of the items will be dried well, and only a small amount of laundry will have moisture left. I don't want to bother checking whether it's dry or not, so I use the normal dry mode for drying, and after washing, I put it on a drying tray and let it dry naturally. [Overall] - Buy 30 minutes to 1 hour of free time every day with money - If you're not a single-person household, the dishwasher is an unbeatable 12-person option - It's a good choice if you can overlook some of the shortcomings. Note - If you want to install it under the cooking range, it doesn't matter if you use a gas range, but if you use an induction or highlight, they say there's an additional cost for adding insulation between the dishwasher. - If you tell the installer about the lower cabinet of the sink that was removed during installation, they will collect it for free. - The furniture installer first visits for the installation, disassembling the lower cabinet, wiring, and cutting the hole under the sink. Then, the dishwasher installer comes 1-2 days later. There was no installation fee or delivery fee. Comments (English): [ A hard-working aunt from 2020 ] || ---------------- || It's been two weeks since I've been with Auntie Dishwasher. During the Lunar New Year holiday, I was cooking various dishes at home and washing dishes when suddenly I got a dishwasher. I went to the department store that day and saw LG and Samsung dishwashers, but both of them cost 1.7 million won. 'I'm the only one who doesn't have a dishwasher. ' I searched Coupang and found a good dishwasher for 700,000 won (with card discount). I thought something was strange and checked the details page, but this product was a 2020 model. The department store was a 2021 model. I asked a department store employee for nearly an hour and asked them carefully. I will start a comparative review between the 2021 model and the 2020 model that I actually used for 2 weeks. The review was written in the order of [Pros], [Cons], and [Overall]. [Pros] - It is cheap. It is about 1 million won cheaper than the 2021 model, but there were three major differences between the two. 1. Addition of a dedicated cutlery tray at the top. The 2020 product was washed by placing the cutlery container in the bottom pot washing compartment, which was a bit disappointing. In the 12-person lower pot tray, excluding the cutlery container, you can put in 1 28cm wok, 1 30cm pan, 1 air fryer inner pot & oil pan, and 1 pan lid. However, if you put in a spoon holder, the size is ambiguous, so you have to take one or two out. The size of the spoon holder is not large, but it is the main reason why the difficulty of Tetris increases rapidly. Also, you have to be careful about where you put the spoons in so that they do not stick to each other in the spoon tray, which is inconvenient. Also, since it is a vertically inserted method, long items such as chopsticks for frying or a spatula get caught on the watering can in the middle and cannot be put in. The 2021 model has a 3-tier tray dedicated to cutlery, so it is convenient because you can just unfold it. 1. Application of water softener filter The 2021 products include a water softener function. Was it LG or Samsung? One company purchased a water softener filter, and the other company only added salt to use it, so the two companies had different forms. However, in places with poor water quality such as Europe or Southeast Asia, a water softener function may be necessary, but is it really necessary in Korea? 3. Without removing the mop holder. For those who live in a rented house, cutting the mop holder can be a problem, but the 2021 model can be installed without cutting the mop holder. The 2020 model must be cut. The three things above were big differences, but in my case, they were shortcomings that I could overlook, so I chose the 2020 model. - Bravo cleaning power I was a distruster of dishwashers, but after actually using it, I found out that it had satisfactory cleaning power. At first, I used to wash it beforehand, but I got lazy and stopped doing that. In particular, I fell in love with the cleaning power when I saw that it completely washed away stubborn grease, such as from air fryer whole pork belly. When I first used it because I was not good at dish Tetris, I was embarrassed because there were some places that weren't cleaned, but after arranging the dishes to match the water nozzle and washing them, they became very clean. - Free time. In the past, I used to wash the dishes for lunch and dinner separately. However, when I used the dishwasher, After purchasing it, I have been saving up enough for two meals and running it at once. After dinner, I just throw the dishes in the dishwasher, finish watching Netflix, and when I come out of the shower, I can see the washed dishes shortly - less burden from dishes piling up. Since I can wash pots and dishes without getting my hands wet even if I use them a lot, I don't feel burdened by using new dishes. Since the dishwasher aunt came, there are many cases where all the woks and pans in the house are mobilized. [Cons] - Washing dishes by hand has become a very, very, very annoying thing. In the past, I used to wash the dishes right after eating, but these days, washing dishes by hand is so annoying. Plastic containers, cutting boards, knives, scissors, etc. that cannot be dishwashed must be washed by hand, which is very annoying. I am looking into replacing all of them with dishwasher-safe products. - The washing time is quite long. If you run the regular course, it takes about an hour and a half. On oily days, if you run the soaking + strong wash, it takes more than 2 hours. If you eat dinner early and run it, it does not matter much, but if you eat dinner late, you may wonder what you are doing after running the dishwasher and rubbing your sleepy eyes. - Regrettable drying Drying is done by blowing the wind once to blow away the moisture, and then evaporating the moisture at high temperature. Since it only evaporates the moisture, the drying effect is greatly reduced if water is accumulated. If water is accumulated in the concave area at the bottom of the dish, the moisture in that area remains. Regular drying takes about 5 minutes, and most cups and dishes dry well. However, about 50% are dried well, and half of them have one or two drops of water, so it is difficult to put them in the cupboard right away. If you run the strong dry mode, it will dry for 30 minutes, and 80-90% of the items will be dried well, and only a small amount of laundry will have moisture left. I don't want to bother checking whether it's dry or not, so I use the normal dry mode for drying, and after washing, I put it on a drying tray and let it dry naturally. [Overall] - Buy 30 minutes to 1 hour of free time every day with money - If you're not a single-person household, the dishwasher is an unbeatable 12-person option - It's a good choice if you can overlook some of the shortcomings. Note - If you want to install it under the cooking range, it doesn't matter if you use a gas range, but if you use an induction or highlight, they say there's an additional cost for adding insulation between the dishwasher. - If you tell the installer about the lower cabinet of the sink that was removed during installation, they will collect it for free. - The furniture installer first visits for the installation, disassembling the lower cabinet, wiring, and cutting the hole under the sink. Then, the dishwasher installer comes 1-2 days later. There was no installation fee or delivery fee. Comments (English): [ A hard-working aunt from 2020 ] || ---------------- || It's been two weeks since I've been with Auntie Dishwasher. During the Lunar New Year holiday, I was cooking various dishes at home and washing dishes when suddenly I got a dishwasher. I went to the department store that day and saw LG and Samsung dishwashers, but both of them cost 1.7 million won. 'I'm the only one who doesn't have a dishwasher. ' I searched Coupang and found a good dishwasher for 700,000 won (with card discount). I thought something was strange and checked the details page, but this product was a 2020 model. The department store was a 2021 model. I asked a department store employee for nearly an hour and asked them carefully. I will start a comparative review between the 2021 model and the 2020 model that I actually used for 2 weeks. The review was written in the order of [Pros], [Cons], and [Overall]. [Pros] - It is cheap. It is about 1 million won cheaper than the 2021 model, but there were three major differences between the two. 1. Addition of a dedicated cutlery tray at the top. The 2020 product was washed by placing the cutlery container in the bottom pot washing compartment, which was a bit disappointing. In the 12-person lower pot tray, excluding the cutlery container, you can put in 1 28cm wok, 1 30cm pan, 1 air fryer inner pot & oil pan, and 1 pan lid. However, if you put in a spoon holder, the size is ambiguous, so you have to take one or two out. The size of the spoon holder is not large, but it is the main reason why the difficulty of Tetris increases rapidly. Also, you have to be careful about where you put the spoons in so that they do not stick to each other in the spoon tray, which is inconvenient. Also, since it is a vertically inserted method, long items such as chopsticks for frying or a spatula get caught on the watering can in the middle and cannot be put in. The 2021 model has a 3-tier tray dedicated to cutlery, so it is convenient because you can just unfold it. 1. Application of water softener filter The 2021 products include a water softener function. Was it LG or Samsung? One company purchased a water softener filter, and the other company only added salt to use it, so the two companies had different forms. However, in places with poor water quality such as Europe or Southeast Asia, a water softener function may be necessary, but is it really necessary in Korea? 3. Without removing the mop holder. For those who live in a rented house, cutting the mop holder can be a problem, but the 2021 model can be installed without cutting the mop holder. The 2020 model must be cut. The three things above were big differences, but in my case, they were shortcomings that I could overlook, so I chose the 2020 model. - Bravo cleaning power I was a distruster of dishwashers, but after actually using it, I found out that it had satisfactory cleaning power. At first, I used to wash it beforehand, but I got lazy and stopped doing that. In particular, I fell in love with the cleaning power when I saw that it completely washed away stubborn grease, such as from air fryer whole pork belly. When I first used it because I was not good at dish Tetris, I was embarrassed because there were some places that weren't cleaned, but after arranging the dishes to match the water nozzle and washing them, they became very clean. - Free time. In the past, I used to wash the dishes for lunch and dinner separately. However, when I used the dishwasher, After purchasing it, I have been saving up enough for two meals and running it at once. After dinner, I just throw the dishes in the dishwasher, finish watching Netflix, and when I come out of the shower, I can see the washed dishes shortly - less burden from dishes piling up. Since I can wash pots and dishes without getting my hands wet even if I use them a lot, I don't feel burdened by using new dishes. Since the dishwasher aunt came, there are many cases where all the woks and pans in the house are mobilized. [Cons] - Washing dishes by hand has become a very, very, very annoying thing. In the past, I used to wash the dishes right after eating, but these days, washing dishes by hand is so annoying. Plastic containers, cutting boards, knives, scissors, etc. that cannot be dishwashed must be washed by hand, which is very annoying. I am looking into replacing all of them with dishwasher-safe products. - The washing time is quite long. If you run the regular course, it takes about an hour and a half. On oily days, if you run the soaking + strong wash, it takes more than 2 hours. If you eat dinner early and run it, it does not matter much, but if you eat dinner late, you may wonder what you are doing after running the dishwasher and rubbing your sleepy eyes. - Regrettable drying Drying is done by blowing the wind once to blow away the moisture, and then evaporating the moisture at high temperature. Since it only evaporates the moisture, the drying effect is greatly reduced if water is accumulated. If water is accumulated in the concave area at the bottom of the dish, the moisture in that area remains. Regular drying takes about 5 minutes, and most cups and dishes dry well. However, about 50% are dried well, and half of them have one or two drops of water, so it is difficult to put them in the cupboard right away. If you run the strong dry mode, it will dry for 30 minutes, and 80-90% of the items will be dried well, and only a small amount of laundry will have moisture left. I don't want to bother checking whether it's dry or not, so I use the normal dry mode for drying, and after washing, I put it on a drying tray and let it dry naturally. [Overall] - Buy 30 minutes to 1 hour of free time every day with money - If you're not a single-person household, the dishwasher is an unbeatable 12-person option - It's a good choice if you can overlook some of the shortcomings. Note - If you want to install it under the cooking range, it doesn't matter if you use a gas range, but if you use an induction or highlight, they say there's an additional cost for adding insulation between the dishwasher. - If you tell the installer about the lower cabinet of the sink that was removed during installation, they will collect it for free. - The furniture installer first visits for the installation, disassembling the lower cabinet, wiring, and cutting the hole under the sink. Then, the dishwasher installer comes 1-2 days later. There was no installation fee or delivery fee. Comments (English): [ A hard-working aunt from 2020 ] || ---------------- || It's been two weeks since I've been with Auntie Dishwasher. During the Lunar New Year holiday, I was cooking various dishes at home and washing dishes when suddenly I got a dishwasher. I went to the department store that day and saw LG and Samsung dishwashers, but both of them cost 1.7 million won. 'I'm the only one who doesn't have a dishwasher. ' I searched Coupang and found a good dishwasher for 700,000 won (with card discount). I thought something was strange and checked the details page, but this product was a 2020 model. The department store was a 2021 model. I asked a department store employee for nearly an hour and asked them carefully. I will start a comparative review between the 2021 model and the 2020 model that I actually used for 2 weeks. The review was written in the order of [Pros], [Cons], and [Overall]. [Pros] - It is cheap. It is about 1 million won cheaper than the 2021 model, but there were three major differences between the two. 1. Addition of a dedicated cutlery tray at the top. The 2020 product was washed by placing the cutlery container in the bottom pot washing compartment, which was a bit disappointing. In the 12-person lower pot tray, excluding the cutlery container, you can put in 1 28cm wok, 1 30cm pan, 1 air fryer inner pot & oil pan, and 1 pan lid. However, if you put in a spoon holder, the size is ambiguous, so you have to take one or two out. The size of the spoon holder is not large, but it is the main reason why the difficulty of Tetris increases rapidly. Also, you have to be careful about where you put the spoons in so that they do not stick to each other in the spoon tray, which is inconvenient. Also, since it is a vertically inserted method, long items such as chopsticks for frying or a spatula get caught on the watering can in the middle and cannot be put in. The 2021 model has a 3-tier tray dedicated to cutlery, so it is convenient because you can just unfold it. 1. Application of water softener filter The 2021 products include a water softener function. Was it LG or Samsung? One company purchased a water softener filter, and the other company only added salt to use it, so the two companies had different forms. However, in places with poor water quality such as Europe or Southeast Asia, a water softener function may be necessary, but is it really necessary in Korea? 3. Without removing the mop holder. For those who live in a rented house, cutting the mop holder can be a problem, but the 2021 model can be installed without cutting the mop holder. The 2020 model must be cut. The three things above were big differences, but in my case, they were shortcomings that I could overlook, so I chose the 2020 model. - Bravo cleaning power I was a distruster of dishwashers, but after actually using it, I found out that it had satisfactory cleaning power. At first, I used to wash it beforehand, but I got lazy and stopped doing that. In particular, I fell in love with the cleaning power when I saw that it completely washed away stubborn grease, such as from air fryer whole pork belly. When I first used it because I was not good at dish Tetris, I was embarrassed because there were some places that weren't cleaned, but after arranging the dishes to match the water nozzle and washing them, they became very clean. - Free time. In the past, I used to wash the dishes for lunch and dinner separately. However, when I used the dishwasher, After purchasing it, I have been saving up enough for two meals and running it at once. After dinner, I just throw the dishes in the dishwasher, finish watching Netflix, and when I come out of the shower, I can see the washed dishes shortly - less burden from dishes piling up. Since I can wash pots and dishes without getting my hands wet even if I use them a lot, I don't feel burdened by using new dishes. Since the dishwasher aunt came, there are many cases where all the woks and pans in the house are mobilized. [Cons] - Washing dishes by hand has become a very, very, very annoying thing. In the past, I used to wash the dishes right after eating, but these days, washing dishes by hand is so annoying. Plastic containers, cutting boards, knives, scissors, etc. that cannot be dishwashed must be washed by hand, which is very annoying. I am looking into replacing all of them with dishwasher-safe products. - The washing time is quite long. If you run the regular course, it takes about an hour and a half. On oily days, if you run the soaking + strong wash, it takes more than 2 hours. If you eat dinner early and run it, it does not matter much, but if you eat dinner late, you may wonder what you are doing after running the dishwasher and rubbing your sleepy eyes. - Regrettable drying Drying is done by blowing the wind once to blow away the moisture, and then evaporating the moisture at high temperature. Since it only evaporates the moisture, the drying effect is greatly reduced if water is accumulated. If water is accumulated in the concave area at the bottom of the dish, the moisture in that area remains. Regular drying takes about 5 minutes, and most cups and dishes dry well. However, about 50% are dried well, and half of them have one or two drops of water, so it is difficult to put them in the cupboard right away. If you run the strong dry mode, it will dry for 30 minutes, and 80-90% of the items will be dried well, and only a small amount of laundry will have moisture left. I don't want to bother checking whether it's dry or not, so I use the normal dry mode for drying, and after washing, I put it on a drying tray and let it dry naturally. [Overall] - Buy 30 minutes to 1 hour of free time every day with money - If you're not a single-person household, the dishwasher is an unbeatable 12-person option - It's a good choice if you can overlook some of the shortcomings. Note - If you want to install it under the cooking range, it doesn't matter if you use a gas range, but if you use an induction or highlight, they say there's an additional cost for adding insulation between the dishwasher. - If you tell the installer about the lower cabinet of the sink that was removed during installation, they will collect it for free. - The furniture installer first visits for the installation, disassembling the lower cabinet, wiring, and cutting the hole under the sink. Then, the dishwasher installer comes 1-2 days later. There was no installation fee or delivery fee. Comments (English): [ A hard-working aunt from 2020 ] || ---------------- || It's been two weeks since I've been with Auntie Dishwasher. During the Lunar New Year holiday, I was cooking various dishes at home and washing dishes when suddenly I got a dishwasher. I went to the department store that day and saw LG and Samsung dishwashers, but both of them cost 1.7 million won. 'I'm the only one who doesn't have a dishwasher. ' I searched Coupang and found a good dishwasher for 700,000 won (with card discount). I thought something was strange and checked the details page, but this product was a 2020 model. The department store was a 2021 model. I asked a department store employee for nearly an hour and asked them carefully. I will start a comparative review between the 2021 model and the 2020 model that I actually used for 2 weeks. The review was written in the order of [Pros], [Cons], and [Overall]. [Pros] - It is cheap. It is about 1 million won cheaper than the 2021 model, but there were three major differences between the two. 1. Addition of a dedicated cutlery tray at the top. The 2020 product was washed by placing the cutlery container in the bottom pot washing compartment, which was a bit disappointing. In the 12-person lower pot tray, excluding the cutlery container, you can put in 1 28cm wok, 1 30cm pan, 1 air fryer inner pot & oil pan, and 1 pan lid. However, if you put in a spoon holder, the size is ambiguous, so you have to take one or two out. The size of the spoon holder is not large, but it is the main reason why the difficulty of Tetris increases rapidly. Also, you have to be careful about where you put the spoons in so that they do not stick to each other in the spoon tray, which is inconvenient. Also, since it is a vertically inserted method, long items such as chopsticks for frying or a spatula get caught on the watering can in the middle and cannot be put in. The 2021 model has a 3-tier tray dedicated to cutlery, so it is convenient because you can just unfold it. 1. Application of water softener filter The 2021 products include a water softener function. Was it LG or Samsung? One company purchased a water softener filter, and the other company only added salt to use it, so the two companies had different forms. However, in places with poor water quality such as Europe or Southeast Asia, a water softener function may be necessary, but is it really necessary in Korea? 3. Without removing the mop holder. For those who live in a rented house, cutting the mop holder can be a problem, but the 2021 model can be installed without cutting the mop holder. The 2020 model must be cut. The three things above were big differences, but in my case, they were shortcomings that I could overlook, so I chose the 2020 model. - Bravo cleaning power I was a distruster of dishwashers, but after actually using it, I found out that it had satisfactory cleaning power. At first, I used to wash it beforehand, but I got lazy and stopped doing that. In particular, I fell in love with the cleaning power when I saw that it completely washed away stubborn grease, such as from air fryer whole pork belly. When I first used it because I was not good at dish Tetris, I was embarrassed because there were some places that weren't cleaned, but after arranging the dishes to match the water nozzle and washing them, they became very clean. - Free time. In the past, I used to wash the dishes for lunch and dinner separately. However, when I used the dishwasher, After purchasing it, I have been saving up enough for two meals and running it at once. After dinner, I just throw the dishes in the dishwasher, finish watching Netflix, and when I come out of the shower, I can see the washed dishes shortly - less burden from dishes piling up. Since I can wash pots and dishes without getting my hands wet even if I use them a lot, I don't feel burdened by using new dishes. Since the dishwasher aunt came, there are many cases where all the woks and pans in the house are mobilized. [Cons] - Washing dishes by hand has become a very, very, very annoying thing. In the past, I used to wash the dishes right after eating, but these days, washing dishes by hand is so annoying. Plastic containers, cutting boards, knives, scissors, etc. that cannot be dishwashed must be washed by hand, which is very annoying. I am looking into replacing all of them with dishwasher-safe products. - The washing time is quite long. If you run the regular course, it takes about an hour and a half. On oily days, if you run the soaking + strong wash, it takes more than 2 hours. If you eat dinner early and run it, it does not matter much, but if you eat dinner late, you may wonder what you are doing after running the dishwasher and rubbing your sleepy eyes. - Regrettable drying Drying is done by blowing the wind once to blow away the moisture, and then evaporating the moisture at high temperature. Since it only evaporates the moisture, the drying effect is greatly reduced if water is accumulated. If water is accumulated in the concave area at the bottom of the dish, the moisture in that area remains. Regular drying takes about 5 minutes, and most cups and dishes dry well. However, about 50% are dried well, and half of them have one or two drops of water, so it is difficult to put them in the cupboard right away. If you run the strong dry mode, it will dry for 30 minutes, and 80-90% of the items will be dried well, and only a small amount of laundry will have moisture left. I don't want to bother checking whether it's dry or not, so I use the normal dry mode for drying, and after washing, I put it on a drying tray and let it dry naturally. [Overall] - Buy 30 minutes to 1 hour of free time every day with money - If you're not a single-person household, the dishwasher is an unbeatable 12-person option - It's a good choice if you can overlook some of the shortcomings. Note - If you want to install it under the cooking range, it doesn't matter if you use a gas range, but if you use an induction or highlight, they say there's an additional cost for adding insulation between the dishwasher. - If you tell the installer about the lower cabinet of the sink that was removed during installation, they will collect it for free. - The furniture installer first visits for the installation, disassembling the lower cabinet, wiring, and cutting the hole under the sink. Then, the dishwasher installer comes 1-2 days later. There was no installation fee or delivery fee. Comments (English): [ A hard-working aunt from 2020 ] || ---------------- || It's been two weeks since I've been with Auntie Dishwasher. During the Lunar New Year holiday, I was cooking various dishes at home and washing dishes when suddenly I got a dishwasher. I went to the department store that day and saw LG and Samsung dishwashers, but both of them cost 1.7 million won. 'I'm the only one who doesn't have a dishwasher. ' I searched Coupang and found a good dishwasher for 700,000 won (with card discount). I thought something was strange and checked the details page, but this product was a 2020 model. The department store was a 2021 model. I asked a department store employee for nearly an hour and asked them carefully. I will start a comparative review between the 2021 model and the 2020 model that I actually used for 2 weeks. The review was written in the order of [Pros], [Cons], and [Overall]. [Pros] - It is cheap. It is about 1 million won cheaper than the 2021 model, but there were three major differences between the two. 1. Addition of a dedicated cutlery tray at the top. The 2020 product was washed by placing the cutlery container in the bottom pot washing compartment, which was a bit disappointing. In the 12-person lower pot tray, excluding the cutlery container, you can put in 1 28cm wok, 1 30cm pan, 1 air fryer inner pot & oil pan, and 1 pan lid. However, if you put in a spoon holder, the size is ambiguous, so you have to take one or two out. The size of the spoon holder is not large, but it is the main reason why the difficulty of Tetris increases rapidly. Also, you have to be careful about where you put the spoons in so that they do not stick to each other in the spoon tray, which is inconvenient. Also, since it is a vertically inserted method, long items such as chopsticks for frying or a spatula get caught on the watering can in the middle and cannot be put in. The 2021 model has a 3-tier tray dedicated to cutlery, so it is convenient because you can just unfold it. 1. Application of water softener filter The 2021 products include a water softener function. Was it LG or Samsung? One company purchased a water softener filter, and the other company only added salt to use it, so the two companies had different forms. However, in places with poor water quality such as Europe or Southeast Asia, a water softener function may be necessary, but is it really necessary in Korea? 3. Without removing the mop holder. For those who live in a rented house, cutting the mop holder can be a problem, but the 2021 model can be installed without cutting the mop holder. The 2020 model must be cut. The three things above were big differences, but in my case, they were shortcomings that I could overlook, so I chose the 2020 model. - Bravo cleaning power I was a distruster of dishwashers, but after actually using it, I found out that it had satisfactory cleaning power. At first, I used to wash it beforehand, but I got lazy and stopped doing that. In particular, I fell in love with the cleaning power when I saw that it completely washed away stubborn grease, such as from air fryer whole pork belly. When I first used it because I was not good at dish Tetris, I was embarrassed because there were some places that weren't cleaned, but after arranging the dishes to match the water nozzle and washing them, they became very clean. - Free time. In the past, I used to wash the dishes for lunch and dinner separately. However, when I used the dishwasher, After purchasing it, I have been saving up enough for two meals and running it at once. After dinner, I just throw the dishes in the dishwasher, finish watching Netflix, and when I come out of the shower, I can see the washed dishes shortly - less burden from dishes piling up. Since I can wash pots and dishes without getting my hands wet even if I use them a lot, I don't feel burdened by using new dishes. Since the dishwasher aunt came, there are many cases where all the woks and pans in the house are mobilized. [Cons] - Washing dishes by hand has become a very, very, very annoying thing. In the past, I used to wash the dishes right after eating, but these days, washing dishes by hand is so annoying. Plastic containers, cutting boards, knives, scissors, etc. that cannot be dishwashed must be washed by hand, which is very annoying. I am looking into replacing all of them with dishwasher-safe products. - The washing time is quite long. If you run the regular course, it takes about an hour and a half. On oily days, if you run the soaking + strong wash, it takes more than 2 hours. If you eat dinner early and run it, it does not matter much, but if you eat dinner late, you may wonder what you are doing after running the dishwasher and rubbing your sleepy eyes. - Regrettable drying Drying is done by blowing the wind once to blow away the moisture, and then evaporating the moisture at high temperature. Since it only evaporates the moisture, the drying effect is greatly reduced if water is accumulated. If water is accumulated in the concave area at the bottom of the dish, the moisture in that area remains. Regular drying takes about 5 minutes, and most cups and dishes dry well. However, about 50% are dried well, and half of them have one or two drops of water, so it is difficult to put them in the cupboard right away. If you run the strong dry mode, it will dry for 30 minutes, and 80-90% of the items will be dried well, and only a small amount of laundry will have moisture left. I don't want to bother checking whether it's dry or not, so I use the normal dry mode for drying, and after washing, I put it on a drying tray and let it dry naturally. [Overall] - Buy 30 minutes to 1 hour of free time every day with money - If you're not a single-person household, the dishwasher is an unbeatable 12-person option - It's a good choice if you can overlook some of the shortcomings. Note - If you want to install it under the cooking range, it doesn't matter if you use a gas range, but if you use an induction or highlight, they say there's an additional cost for adding insulation between the dishwasher. - If you tell the installer about the lower cabinet of the sink that was removed during installation, they will collect it for free. - The furniture installer first visits for the installation, disassembling the lower cabinet, wiring, and cutting the hole under the sink. Then, the dishwasher installer comes 1-2 days later. There was no installation fee or delivery fee.
