Comments (English): [ A hard-working aunt from 2020 ] || ---------------- || It's been two weeks since I've been with Auntie Dishwasher. During the Lunar New Year holiday, I was cooking various dishes at home and washing dishes when suddenly I got a dishwasher. I went to the department store that day and saw LG and Samsung dishwashers, but both of them cost 1.7 million won. 'I'm the only one who doesn't have a dishwasher. ' I searched Coupang and found a good dishwasher for 700,000 won (with card discount). I thought something was strange and checked the details page, but this product was a 2020 model. The department store was a 2021 model. I asked a department store employee for nearly an hour and asked them carefully. I will start a comparative review between the 2021 model and the 2020 model that I actually used for 2 weeks. The review was written in the order of [Pros], [Cons], and [Overall]. [Pros] - It is cheap. It is about 1 million won cheaper than the 2021 model, but there were three major differences between the two. 1. Addition of a dedicated cutlery tray at the top. The 2020 product was washed by placing the cutlery container in the bottom pot washing compartment, which was a bit disappointing. In the 12-person lower pot tray, excluding the cutlery container, you can put in 1 28cm wok, 1 30cm pan, 1 air fryer inner pot & oil pan, and 1 pan lid. However, if you put in a spoon holder, the size is ambiguous, so you have to take one or two out. The size of the spoon holder is not large, but it is the main reason why the difficulty of Tetris increases rapidly. Also, you have to be careful about where you put the spoons in so that they do not stick to each other in the spoon tray, which is inconvenient. Also, since it is a vertically inserted method, long items such as chopsticks for frying or a spatula get caught on the watering can in the middle and cannot be put in. The 2021 model has a 3-tier tray dedicated to cutlery, so it is convenient because you can just unfold it. 1. Application of water softener filter The 2021 products include a water softener function. Was it LG or Samsung? One company purchased a water softener filter, and the other company only added salt to use it, so the two companies had different forms. However, in places with poor water quality such as Europe or Southeast Asia, a water softener function may be necessary, but is it really necessary in Korea? 3. Without removing the mop holder. For those who live in a rented house, cutting the mop holder can be a problem, but the 2021 model can be installed without cutting the mop holder. The 2020 model must be cut. The three things above were big differences, but in my case, they were shortcomings that I could overlook, so I chose the 2020 model. - Bravo cleaning power I was a distruster of dishwashers, but after actually using it, I found out that it had satisfactory cleaning power. At first, I used to wash it beforehand, but I got lazy and stopped doing that. In particular, I fell in love with the cleaning power when I saw that it completely washed away stubborn grease, such as from air fryer whole pork belly. When I first used it because I was not good at dish Tetris, I was embarrassed because there were some places that weren't cleaned, but after arranging the dishes to match the water nozzle and washing them, they became very clean. - Free time. In the past, I used to wash the dishes for lunch and dinner separately. However, when I used the dishwasher, After purchasing it, I have been saving up enough for two meals and running it at once. After dinner, I just throw the dishes in the dishwasher, finish watching Netflix, and when I come out of the shower, I can see the washed dishes shortly - less burden from dishes piling up. Since I can wash pots and dishes without getting my hands wet even if I use them a lot, I don't feel burdened by using new dishes. Since the dishwasher aunt came, there are many cases where all the woks and pans in the house are mobilized. [Cons] - Washing dishes by hand has become a very, very, very annoying thing. In the past, I used to wash the dishes right after eating, but these days, washing dishes by hand is so annoying. Plastic containers, cutting boards, knives, scissors, etc. that cannot be dishwashed must be washed by hand, which is very annoying. I am looking into replacing all of them with dishwasher-safe products. - The washing time is quite long. If you run the regular course, it takes about an hour and a half. On oily days, if you run the soaking + strong wash, it takes more than 2 hours. If you eat dinner early and run it, it does not matter much, but if you eat dinner late, you may wonder what you are doing after running the dishwasher and rubbing your sleepy eyes. - Regrettable drying Drying is done by blowing the wind once to blow away the moisture, and then evaporating the moisture at high temperature. Since it only evaporates the moisture, the drying effect is greatly reduced if water is accumulated. If water is accumulated in the concave area at the bottom of the dish, the moisture in that area remains. Regular drying takes about 5 minutes, and most cups and dishes dry well. However, about 50% are dried well, and half of them have one or two drops of water, so it is difficult to put them in the cupboard right away. If you run the strong dry mode, it will dry for 30 minutes, and 80-90% of the items will be dried well, and only a small amount of laundry will have moisture left. I don't want to bother checking whether it's dry or not, so I use the normal dry mode for drying, and after washing, I put it on a drying tray and let it dry naturally. [Overall] - Buy 30 minutes to 1 hour of free time every day with money - If you're not a single-person household, the dishwasher is an unbeatable 12-person option - It's a good choice if you can overlook some of the shortcomings. Note - If you want to install it under the cooking range, it doesn't matter if you use a gas range, but if you use an induction or highlight, they say there's an additional cost for adding insulation between the dishwasher. - If you tell the installer about the lower cabinet of the sink that was removed during installation, they will collect it for free. - The furniture installer first visits for the installation, disassembling the lower cabinet, wiring, and cutting the hole under the sink. Then, the dishwasher installer comes 1-2 days later. There was no installation fee or delivery fee. If you request a previous installation + reassemble the lower cabinet, it will cost around 100,000 won. It is said that an amount of money of that level is generated

Comments (English): [ A hard-working aunt from 2020 ] || ---------------- || It's been two weeks since I've been with Auntie Dishwasher. During the Lunar New Year holiday, I was cooking various dishes at home and washing dishes when suddenly I got a dishwasher. I went to the department store that day and saw LG and Samsung dishwashers, but both of them cost 1.7 million won. 'I'm the only one who doesn't have a dishwasher. ' I searched Coupang and found a good dishwasher for 700,000 won (with card discount). I thought something was strange and checked the details page, but this product was a 2020 model. The department store was a 2021 model. I asked a department store employee for nearly an hour and asked them carefully. I will start a comparative review between the 2021 model and the 2020 model that I actually used for 2 weeks. The review was written in the order of [Pros], [Cons], and [Overall]. [Pros] - It is cheap. It is about 1 million won cheaper than the 2021 model, but there were three major differences between the two. 1. Addition of a dedicated cutlery tray at the top. The 2020 product was washed by placing the cutlery container in the bottom pot washing compartment, which was a bit disappointing. In the 12-person lower pot tray, excluding the cutlery container, you can put in 1 28cm wok, 1 30cm pan, 1 air fryer inner pot & oil pan, and 1 pan lid. However, if you put in a spoon holder, the size is ambiguous, so you have to take one or two out. The size of the spoon holder is not large, but it is the main reason why the difficulty of Tetris increases rapidly. Also, you have to be careful about where you put the spoons in so that they do not stick to each other in the spoon tray, which is inconvenient. Also, since it is a vertically inserted method, long items such as chopsticks for frying or a spatula get caught on the watering can in the middle and cannot be put in. The 2021 model has a 3-tier tray dedicated to cutlery, so it is convenient because you can just unfold it. 1. Application of water softener filter The 2021 products include a water softener function. Was it LG or Samsung? One company purchased a water softener filter, and the other company only added salt to use it, so the two companies had different forms. However, in places with poor water quality such as Europe or Southeast Asia, a water softener function may be necessary, but is it really necessary in Korea? 3. Without removing the mop holder. For those who live in a rented house, cutting the mop holder can be a problem, but the 2021 model can be installed without cutting the mop holder. The 2020 model must be cut. The three things above were big differences, but in my case, they were shortcomings that I could overlook, so I chose the 2020 model. - Bravo cleaning power I was a distruster of dishwashers, but after actually using it, I found out that it had satisfactory cleaning power. At first, I used to wash it beforehand, but I got lazy and stopped doing that. In particular, I fell in love with the cleaning power when I saw that it completely washed away stubborn grease, such as from air fryer whole pork belly. When I first used it because I was not good at dish Tetris, I was embarrassed because there were some places that weren't cleaned, but after arranging the dishes to match the water nozzle and washing them, they became very clean. - Free time. In the past, I used to wash the dishes for lunch and dinner separately. However, when I used the dishwasher, After purchasing it, I have been saving up enough for two meals and running it at once. After dinner, I just throw the dishes in the dishwasher, finish watching Netflix, and when I come out of the shower, I can see the washed dishes shortly - less burden from dishes piling up. Since I can wash pots and dishes without getting my hands wet even if I use them a lot, I don't feel burdened by using new dishes. Since the dishwasher aunt came, there are many cases where all the woks and pans in the house are mobilized. [Cons] - Washing dishes by hand has become a very, very, very annoying thing. In the past, I used to wash the dishes right after eating, but these days, washing dishes by hand is so annoying. Plastic containers, cutting boards, knives, scissors, etc. that cannot be dishwashed must be washed by hand, which is very annoying. I am looking into replacing all of them with dishwasher-safe products. - The washing time is quite long. If you run the regular course, it takes about an hour and a half. On oily days, if you run the soaking + strong wash, it takes more than 2 hours. If you eat dinner early and run it, it does not matter much, but if you eat dinner late, you may wonder what you are doing after running the dishwasher and rubbing your sleepy eyes. - Regrettable drying Drying is done by blowing the wind once to blow away the moisture, and then evaporating the moisture at high temperature. Since it only evaporates the moisture, the drying effect is greatly reduced if water is accumulated. If water is accumulated in the concave area at the bottom of the dish, the moisture in that area remains. Regular drying takes about 5 minutes, and most cups and dishes dry well. However, about 50% are dried well, and half of them have one or two drops of water, so it is difficult to put them in the cupboard right away. If you run the strong dry mode, it will dry for 30 minutes, and 80-90% of the items will be dried well, and only a small amount of laundry will have moisture left. I don't want to bother checking whether it's dry or not, so I use the normal dry mode for drying, and after washing, I put it on a drying tray and let it dry naturally. [Overall] - Buy 30 minutes to 1 hour of free time every day with money - If you're not a single-person household, the dishwasher is an unbeatable 12-person option - It's a good choice if you can overlook some of the shortcomings. Note - If you want to install it under the cooking range, it doesn't matter if you use a gas range, but if you use an induction or highlight, they say there's an additional cost for adding insulation between the dishwasher. - If you tell the installer about the lower cabinet of the sink that was removed during installation, they will collect it for free. - The furniture installer first visits for the installation, disassembling the lower cabinet, wiring, and cutting the hole under the sink. Then, the dishwasher installer comes 1-2 days later. There was no installation fee or delivery fee. If you request a previous installation + reassemble the lower cabinet, it will cost around 100,000 won. It is said that an amount of money of that level is generated

Comments (English): [ A hard-working aunt from 2020 ] || ---------------- || It's been two weeks since I've been with Auntie Dishwasher. During the Lunar New Year holiday, I was cooking various dishes at home and washing dishes when suddenly I got a dishwasher. I went to the department store that day and saw LG and Samsung dishwashers, but both of them cost 1.7 million won. 'I'm the only one who doesn't have a dishwasher. ' I searched Coupang and found a good dishwasher for 700,000 won (with card discount). I thought something was strange and checked the details page, but this product was a 2020 model. The department store was a 2021 model. I asked a department store employee for nearly an hour and asked them carefully. I will start a comparative review between the 2021 model and the 2020 model that I actually used for 2 weeks. The review was written in the order of [Pros], [Cons], and [Overall]. [Pros] - It is cheap. It is about 1 million won cheaper than the 2021 model, but there were three major differences between the two. 1. Addition of a dedicated cutlery tray at the top. The 2020 product was washed by placing the cutlery container in the bottom pot washing compartment, which was a bit disappointing. In the 12-person lower pot tray, excluding the cutlery container, you can put in 1 28cm wok, 1 30cm pan, 1 air fryer inner pot & oil pan, and 1 pan lid. However, if you put in a spoon holder, the size is ambiguous, so you have to take one or two out. The size of the spoon holder is not large, but it is the main reason why the difficulty of Tetris increases rapidly. Also, you have to be careful about where you put the spoons in so that they do not stick to each other in the spoon tray, which is inconvenient. Also, since it is a vertically inserted method, long items such as chopsticks for frying or a spatula get caught on the watering can in the middle and cannot be put in. The 2021 model has a 3-tier tray dedicated to cutlery, so it is convenient because you can just unfold it. 1. Application of water softener filter The 2021 products include a water softener function. Was it LG or Samsung? One company purchased a water softener filter, and the other company only added salt to use it, so the two companies had different forms. However, in places with poor water quality such as Europe or Southeast Asia, a water softener function may be necessary, but is it really necessary in Korea? 3. Without removing the mop holder. For those who live in a rented house, cutting the mop holder can be a problem, but the 2021 model can be installed without cutting the mop holder. The 2020 model must be cut. The three things above were big differences, but in my case, they were shortcomings that I could overlook, so I chose the 2020 model. - Bravo cleaning power I was a distruster of dishwashers, but after actually using it, I found out that it had satisfactory cleaning power. At first, I used to wash it beforehand, but I got lazy and stopped doing that. In particular, I fell in love with the cleaning power when I saw that it completely washed away stubborn grease, such as from air fryer whole pork belly. When I first used it because I was not good at dish Tetris, I was embarrassed because there were some places that weren't cleaned, but after arranging the dishes to match the water nozzle and washing them, they became very clean. - Free time. In the past, I used to wash the dishes for lunch and dinner separately. However, when I used the dishwasher, After purchasing it, I have been saving up enough for two meals and running it at once. After dinner, I just throw the dishes in the dishwasher, finish watching Netflix, and when I come out of the shower, I can see the washed dishes shortly - less burden from dishes piling up. Since I can wash pots and dishes without getting my hands wet even if I use them a lot, I don't feel burdened by using new dishes. Since the dishwasher aunt came, there are many cases where all the woks and pans in the house are mobilized. [Cons] - Washing dishes by hand has become a very, very, very annoying thing. In the past, I used to wash the dishes right after eating, but these days, washing dishes by hand is so annoying. Plastic containers, cutting boards, knives, scissors, etc. that cannot be dishwashed must be washed by hand, which is very annoying. I am looking into replacing all of them with dishwasher-safe products. - The washing time is quite long. If you run the regular course, it takes about an hour and a half. On oily days, if you run the soaking + strong wash, it takes more than 2 hours. If you eat dinner early and run it, it does not matter much, but if you eat dinner late, you may wonder what you are doing after running the dishwasher and rubbing your sleepy eyes. - Regrettable drying Drying is done by blowing the wind once to blow away the moisture, and then evaporating the moisture at high temperature. Since it only evaporates the moisture, the drying effect is greatly reduced if water is accumulated. If water is accumulated in the concave area at the bottom of the dish, the moisture in that area remains. Regular drying takes about 5 minutes, and most cups and dishes dry well. However, about 50% are dried well, and half of them have one or two drops of water, so it is difficult to put them in the cupboard right away. If you run the strong dry mode, it will dry for 30 minutes, and 80-90% of the items will be dried well, and only a small amount of laundry will have moisture left. I don't want to bother checking whether it's dry or not, so I use the normal dry mode for drying, and after washing, I put it on a drying tray and let it dry naturally. [Overall] - Buy 30 minutes to 1 hour of free time every day with money - If you're not a single-person household, the dishwasher is an unbeatable 12-person option - It's a good choice if you can overlook some of the shortcomings. Note - If you want to install it under the cooking range, it doesn't matter if you use a gas range, but if you use an induction or highlight, they say there's an additional cost for adding insulation between the dishwasher. - If you tell the installer about the lower cabinet of the sink that was removed during installation, they will collect it for free. - The furniture installer first visits for the installation, disassembling the lower cabinet, wiring, and cutting the hole under the sink. Then, the dishwasher installer comes 1-2 days later. There was no installation fee or delivery fee. If you request a previous installation + reassemble the lower cabinet, it will cost around 100,000 won. It is said that an amount of money of that level is generated

Comments (English): [ A hard-working aunt from 2020 ] || ---------------- || It's been two weeks since I've been with Auntie Dishwasher. During the Lunar New Year holiday, I was cooking various dishes at home and washing dishes when suddenly I got a dishwasher. I went to the department store that day and saw LG and Samsung dishwashers, but both of them cost 1.7 million won. 'I'm the only one who doesn't have a dishwasher. ' I searched Coupang and found a good dishwasher for 700,000 won (with card discount). I thought something was strange and checked the details page, but this product was a 2020 model. The department store was a 2021 model. I asked a department store employee for nearly an hour and asked them carefully. I will start a comparative review between the 2021 model and the 2020 model that I actually used for 2 weeks. The review was written in the order of [Pros], [Cons], and [Overall]. [Pros] - It is cheap. It is about 1 million won cheaper than the 2021 model, but there were three major differences between the two. 1. Addition of a dedicated cutlery tray at the top. The 2020 product was washed by placing the cutlery container in the bottom pot washing compartment, which was a bit disappointing. In the 12-person lower pot tray, excluding the cutlery container, you can put in 1 28cm wok, 1 30cm pan, 1 air fryer inner pot & oil pan, and 1 pan lid. However, if you put in a spoon holder, the size is ambiguous, so you have to take one or two out. The size of the spoon holder is not large, but it is the main reason why the difficulty of Tetris increases rapidly. Also, you have to be careful about where you put the spoons in so that they do not stick to each other in the spoon tray, which is inconvenient. Also, since it is a vertically inserted method, long items such as chopsticks for frying or a spatula get caught on the watering can in the middle and cannot be put in. The 2021 model has a 3-tier tray dedicated to cutlery, so it is convenient because you can just unfold it. 1. Application of water softener filter The 2021 products include a water softener function. Was it LG or Samsung? One company purchased a water softener filter, and the other company only added salt to use it, so the two companies had different forms. However, in places with poor water quality such as Europe or Southeast Asia, a water softener function may be necessary, but is it really necessary in Korea? 3. Without removing the mop holder. For those who live in a rented house, cutting the mop holder can be a problem, but the 2021 model can be installed without cutting the mop holder. The 2020 model must be cut. The three things above were big differences, but in my case, they were shortcomings that I could overlook, so I chose the 2020 model. - Bravo cleaning power I was a distruster of dishwashers, but after actually using it, I found out that it had satisfactory cleaning power. At first, I used to wash it beforehand, but I got lazy and stopped doing that. In particular, I fell in love with the cleaning power when I saw that it completely washed away stubborn grease, such as from air fryer whole pork belly. When I first used it because I was not good at dish Tetris, I was embarrassed because there were some places that weren't cleaned, but after arranging the dishes to match the water nozzle and washing them, they became very clean. - Free time. In the past, I used to wash the dishes for lunch and dinner separately. However, when I used the dishwasher, After purchasing it, I have been saving up enough for two meals and running it at once. After dinner, I just throw the dishes in the dishwasher, finish watching Netflix, and when I come out of the shower, I can see the washed dishes shortly - less burden from dishes piling up. Since I can wash pots and dishes without getting my hands wet even if I use them a lot, I don't feel burdened by using new dishes. Since the dishwasher aunt came, there are many cases where all the woks and pans in the house are mobilized. [Cons] - Washing dishes by hand has become a very, very, very annoying thing. In the past, I used to wash the dishes right after eating, but these days, washing dishes by hand is so annoying. Plastic containers, cutting boards, knives, scissors, etc. that cannot be dishwashed must be washed by hand, which is very annoying. I am looking into replacing all of them with dishwasher-safe products. - The washing time is quite long. If you run the regular course, it takes about an hour and a half. On oily days, if you run the soaking + strong wash, it takes more than 2 hours. If you eat dinner early and run it, it does not matter much, but if you eat dinner late, you may wonder what you are doing after running the dishwasher and rubbing your sleepy eyes. - Regrettable drying Drying is done by blowing the wind once to blow away the moisture, and then evaporating the moisture at high temperature. Since it only evaporates the moisture, the drying effect is greatly reduced if water is accumulated. If water is accumulated in the concave area at the bottom of the dish, the moisture in that area remains. Regular drying takes about 5 minutes, and most cups and dishes dry well. However, about 50% are dried well, and half of them have one or two drops of water, so it is difficult to put them in the cupboard right away. If you run the strong dry mode, it will dry for 30 minutes, and 80-90% of the items will be dried well, and only a small amount of laundry will have moisture left. I don't want to bother checking whether it's dry or not, so I use the normal dry mode for drying, and after washing, I put it on a drying tray and let it dry naturally. [Overall] - Buy 30 minutes to 1 hour of free time every day with money - If you're not a single-person household, the dishwasher is an unbeatable 12-person option - It's a good choice if you can overlook some of the shortcomings. Note - If you want to install it under the cooking range, it doesn't matter if you use a gas range, but if you use an induction or highlight, they say there's an additional cost for adding insulation between the dishwasher. - If you tell the installer about the lower cabinet of the sink that was removed during installation, they will collect it for free. - The furniture installer first visits for the installation, disassembling the lower cabinet, wiring, and cutting the hole under the sink. Then, the dishwasher installer comes 1-2 days later. There was no installation fee or delivery fee. If you request a previous installation + reassemble the lower cabinet, it will cost around 100,000 won. It is said that an amount of money of that level is generated

Comments (English): [ A hard-working aunt from 2020 ] || ---------------- || It's been two weeks since I've been with Auntie Dishwasher. During the Lunar New Year holiday, I was cooking various dishes at home and washing dishes when suddenly I got a dishwasher. I went to the department store that day and saw LG and Samsung dishwashers, but both of them cost 1.7 million won. 'I'm the only one who doesn't have a dishwasher. ' I searched Coupang and found a good dishwasher for 700,000 won (with card discount). I thought something was strange and checked the details page, but this product was a 2020 model. The department store was a 2021 model. I asked a department store employee for nearly an hour and asked them carefully. I will start a comparative review between the 2021 model and the 2020 model that I actually used for 2 weeks. The review was written in the order of [Pros], [Cons], and [Overall]. [Pros] - It is cheap. It is about 1 million won cheaper than the 2021 model, but there were three major differences between the two. 1. Addition of a dedicated cutlery tray at the top. The 2020 product was washed by placing the cutlery container in the bottom pot washing compartment, which was a bit disappointing. In the 12-person lower pot tray, excluding the cutlery container, you can put in 1 28cm wok, 1 30cm pan, 1 air fryer inner pot & oil pan, and 1 pan lid. However, if you put in a spoon holder, the size is ambiguous, so you have to take one or two out. The size of the spoon holder is not large, but it is the main reason why the difficulty of Tetris increases rapidly. Also, you have to be careful about where you put the spoons in so that they do not stick to each other in the spoon tray, which is inconvenient. Also, since it is a vertically inserted method, long items such as chopsticks for frying or a spatula get caught on the watering can in the middle and cannot be put in. The 2021 model has a 3-tier tray dedicated to cutlery, so it is convenient because you can just unfold it. 1. Application of water softener filter The 2021 products include a water softener function. Was it LG or Samsung? One company purchased a water softener filter, and the other company only added salt to use it, so the two companies had different forms. However, in places with poor water quality such as Europe or Southeast Asia, a water softener function may be necessary, but is it really necessary in Korea? 3. Without removing the mop holder. For those who live in a rented house, cutting the mop holder can be a problem, but the 2021 model can be installed without cutting the mop holder. The 2020 model must be cut. The three things above were big differences, but in my case, they were shortcomings that I could overlook, so I chose the 2020 model. - Bravo cleaning power I was a distruster of dishwashers, but after actually using it, I found out that it had satisfactory cleaning power. At first, I used to wash it beforehand, but I got lazy and stopped doing that. In particular, I fell in love with the cleaning power when I saw that it completely washed away stubborn grease, such as from air fryer whole pork belly. When I first used it because I was not good at dish Tetris, I was embarrassed because there were some places that weren't cleaned, but after arranging the dishes to match the water nozzle and washing them, they became very clean. - Free time. In the past, I used to wash the dishes for lunch and dinner separately. However, when I used the dishwasher, After purchasing it, I have been saving up enough for two meals and running it at once. After dinner, I just throw the dishes in the dishwasher, finish watching Netflix, and when I come out of the shower, I can see the washed dishes shortly - less burden from dishes piling up. Since I can wash pots and dishes without getting my hands wet even if I use them a lot, I don't feel burdened by using new dishes. Since the dishwasher aunt came, there are many cases where all the woks and pans in the house are mobilized. [Cons] - Washing dishes by hand has become a very, very, very annoying thing. In the past, I used to wash the dishes right after eating, but these days, washing dishes by hand is so annoying. Plastic containers, cutting boards, knives, scissors, etc. that cannot be dishwashed must be washed by hand, which is very annoying. I am looking into replacing all of them with dishwasher-safe products. - The washing time is quite long. If you run the regular course, it takes about an hour and a half. On oily days, if you run the soaking + strong wash, it takes more than 2 hours. If you eat dinner early and run it, it does not matter much, but if you eat dinner late, you may wonder what you are doing after running the dishwasher and rubbing your sleepy eyes. - Regrettable drying Drying is done by blowing the wind once to blow away the moisture, and then evaporating the moisture at high temperature. Since it only evaporates the moisture, the drying effect is greatly reduced if water is accumulated. If water is accumulated in the concave area at the bottom of the dish, the moisture in that area remains. Regular drying takes about 5 minutes, and most cups and dishes dry well. However, about 50% are dried well, and half of them have one or two drops of water, so it is difficult to put them in the cupboard right away. If you run the strong dry mode, it will dry for 30 minutes, and 80-90% of the items will be dried well, and only a small amount of laundry will have moisture left. I don't want to bother checking whether it's dry or not, so I use the normal dry mode for drying, and after washing, I put it on a drying tray and let it dry naturally. [Overall] - Buy 30 minutes to 1 hour of free time every day with money - If you're not a single-person household, the dishwasher is an unbeatable 12-person option - It's a good choice if you can overlook some of the shortcomings. Note - If you want to install it under the cooking range, it doesn't matter if you use a gas range, but if you use an induction or highlight, they say there's an additional cost for adding insulation between the dishwasher. - If you tell the installer about the lower cabinet of the sink that was removed during installation, they will collect it for free. - The furniture installer first visits for the installation, disassembling the lower cabinet, wiring, and cutting the hole under the sink. Then, the dishwasher installer comes 1-2 days later. There was no installation fee or delivery fee. If you request a previous installation + reassemble the lower cabinet, it will cost around 100,000 won. It is said that an amount of money of that level is generated

Comments (English): [ A hard-working aunt from 2020 ] || ---------------- || It's been two weeks since I've been with Auntie Dishwasher. During the Lunar New Year holiday, I was cooking various dishes at home and washing dishes when suddenly I got a dishwasher. I went to the department store that day and saw LG and Samsung dishwashers, but both of them cost 1.7 million won. 'I'm the only one who doesn't have a dishwasher. ' I searched Coupang and found a good dishwasher for 700,000 won (with card discount). I thought something was strange and checked the details page, but this product was a 2020 model. The department store was a 2021 model. I asked a department store employee for nearly an hour and asked them carefully. I will start a comparative review between the 2021 model and the 2020 model that I actually used for 2 weeks. The review was written in the order of [Pros], [Cons], and [Overall]. [Pros] - It is cheap. It is about 1 million won cheaper than the 2021 model, but there were three major differences between the two. 1. Addition of a dedicated cutlery tray at the top. The 2020 product was washed by placing the cutlery container in the bottom pot washing compartment, which was a bit disappointing. In the 12-person lower pot tray, excluding the cutlery container, you can put in 1 28cm wok, 1 30cm pan, 1 air fryer inner pot & oil pan, and 1 pan lid. However, if you put in a spoon holder, the size is ambiguous, so you have to take one or two out. The size of the spoon holder is not large, but it is the main reason why the difficulty of Tetris increases rapidly. Also, you have to be careful about where you put the spoons in so that they do not stick to each other in the spoon tray, which is inconvenient. Also, since it is a vertically inserted method, long items such as chopsticks for frying or a spatula get caught on the watering can in the middle and cannot be put in. The 2021 model has a 3-tier tray dedicated to cutlery, so it is convenient because you can just unfold it. 1. Application of water softener filter The 2021 products include a water softener function. Was it LG or Samsung? One company purchased a water softener filter, and the other company only added salt to use it, so the two companies had different forms. However, in places with poor water quality such as Europe or Southeast Asia, a water softener function may be necessary, but is it really necessary in Korea? 3. Without removing the mop holder. For those who live in a rented house, cutting the mop holder can be a problem, but the 2021 model can be installed without cutting the mop holder. The 2020 model must be cut. The three things above were big differences, but in my case, they were shortcomings that I could overlook, so I chose the 2020 model. - Bravo cleaning power I was a distruster of dishwashers, but after actually using it, I found out that it had satisfactory cleaning power. At first, I used to wash it beforehand, but I got lazy and stopped doing that. In particular, I fell in love with the cleaning power when I saw that it completely washed away stubborn grease, such as from air fryer whole pork belly. When I first used it because I was not good at dish Tetris, I was embarrassed because there were some places that weren't cleaned, but after arranging the dishes to match the water nozzle and washing them, they became very clean. - Free time. In the past, I used to wash the dishes for lunch and dinner separately. However, when I used the dishwasher, After purchasing it, I have been saving up enough for two meals and running it at once. After dinner, I just throw the dishes in the dishwasher, finish watching Netflix, and when I come out of the shower, I can see the washed dishes shortly - less burden from dishes piling up. Since I can wash pots and dishes without getting my hands wet even if I use them a lot, I don't feel burdened by using new dishes. Since the dishwasher aunt came, there are many cases where all the woks and pans in the house are mobilized. [Cons] - Washing dishes by hand has become a very, very, very annoying thing. In the past, I used to wash the dishes right after eating, but these days, washing dishes by hand is so annoying. Plastic containers, cutting boards, knives, scissors, etc. that cannot be dishwashed must be washed by hand, which is very annoying. I am looking into replacing all of them with dishwasher-safe products. - The washing time is quite long. If you run the regular course, it takes about an hour and a half. On oily days, if you run the soaking + strong wash, it takes more than 2 hours. If you eat dinner early and run it, it does not matter much, but if you eat dinner late, you may wonder what you are doing after running the dishwasher and rubbing your sleepy eyes. - Regrettable drying Drying is done by blowing the wind once to blow away the moisture, and then evaporating the moisture at high temperature. Since it only evaporates the moisture, the drying effect is greatly reduced if water is accumulated. If water is accumulated in the concave area at the bottom of the dish, the moisture in that area remains. Regular drying takes about 5 minutes, and most cups and dishes dry well. However, about 50% are dried well, and half of them have one or two drops of water, so it is difficult to put them in the cupboard right away. If you run the strong dry mode, it will dry for 30 minutes, and 80-90% of the items will be dried well, and only a small amount of laundry will have moisture left. I don't want to bother checking whether it's dry or not, so I use the normal dry mode for drying, and after washing, I put it on a drying tray and let it dry naturally. [Overall] - Buy 30 minutes to 1 hour of free time every day with money - If you're not a single-person household, the dishwasher is an unbeatable 12-person option - It's a good choice if you can overlook some of the shortcomings. Note - If you want to install it under the cooking range, it doesn't matter if you use a gas range, but if you use an induction or highlight, they say there's an additional cost for adding insulation between the dishwasher. - If you tell the installer about the lower cabinet of the sink that was removed during installation, they will collect it for free. - The furniture installer first visits for the installation, disassembling the lower cabinet, wiring, and cutting the hole under the sink. Then, the dishwasher installer comes 1-2 days later. There was no installation fee or delivery fee. Comments (English): [ A hard-working aunt from 2020 ] || ---------------- || It's been two weeks since I've been with Auntie Dishwasher. During the Lunar New Year holiday, I was cooking various dishes at home and washing dishes when suddenly I got a dishwasher. I went to the department store that day and saw LG and Samsung dishwashers, but both of them cost 1.7 million won. 'I'm the only one who doesn't have a dishwasher. ' I searched Coupang and found a good dishwasher for 700,000 won (with card discount). I thought something was strange and checked the details page, but this product was a 2020 model. The department store was a 2021 model. I asked a department store employee for nearly an hour and asked them carefully. I will start a comparative review between the 2021 model and the 2020 model that I actually used for 2 weeks. The review was written in the order of [Pros], [Cons], and [Overall]. [Pros] - It is cheap. It is about 1 million won cheaper than the 2021 model, but there were three major differences between the two. 1. Addition of a dedicated cutlery tray at the top. The 2020 product was washed by placing the cutlery container in the bottom pot washing compartment, which was a bit disappointing. In the 12-person lower pot tray, excluding the cutlery container, you can put in 1 28cm wok, 1 30cm pan, 1 air fryer inner pot & oil pan, and 1 pan lid. However, if you put in a spoon holder, the size is ambiguous, so you have to take one or two out. The size of the spoon holder is not large, but it is the main reason why the difficulty of Tetris increases rapidly. Also, you have to be careful about where you put the spoons in so that they do not stick to each other in the spoon tray, which is inconvenient. Also, since it is a vertically inserted method, long items such as chopsticks for frying or a spatula get caught on the watering can in the middle and cannot be put in. The 2021 model has a 3-tier tray dedicated to cutlery, so it is convenient because you can just unfold it. 1. Application of water softener filter The 2021 products include a water softener function. Was it LG or Samsung? One company purchased a water softener filter, and the other company only added salt to use it, so the two companies had different forms. However, in places with poor water quality such as Europe or Southeast Asia, a water softener function may be necessary, but is it really necessary in Korea? 3. Without removing the mop holder. For those who live in a rented house, cutting the mop holder can be a problem, but the 2021 model can be installed without cutting the mop holder. The 2020 model must be cut. The three things above were big differences, but in my case, they were shortcomings that I could overlook, so I chose the 2020 model. - Bravo cleaning power I was a distruster of dishwashers, but after actually using it, I found out that it had satisfactory cleaning power. At first, I used to wash it beforehand, but I got lazy and stopped doing that. In particular, I fell in love with the cleaning power when I saw that it completely washed away stubborn grease, such as from air fryer whole pork belly. When I first used it because I was not good at dish Tetris, I was embarrassed because there were some places that weren't cleaned, but after arranging the dishes to match the water nozzle and washing them, they became very clean. - Free time. In the past, I used to wash the dishes for lunch and dinner separately. However, when I used the dishwasher, After purchasing it, I have been saving up enough for two meals and running it at once. After dinner, I just throw the dishes in the dishwasher, finish watching Netflix, and when I come out of the shower, I can see the washed dishes shortly - less burden from dishes piling up. Since I can wash pots and dishes without getting my hands wet even if I use them a lot, I don't feel burdened by using new dishes. Since the dishwasher aunt came, there are many cases where all the woks and pans in the house are mobilized. [Cons] - Washing dishes by hand has become a very, very, very annoying thing. In the past, I used to wash the dishes right after eating, but these days, washing dishes by hand is so annoying. Plastic containers, cutting boards, knives, scissors, etc. that cannot be dishwashed must be washed by hand, which is very annoying. I am looking into replacing all of them with dishwasher-safe products. - The washing time is quite long. If you run the regular course, it takes about an hour and a half. On oily days, if you run the soaking + strong wash, it takes more than 2 hours. If you eat dinner early and run it, it does not matter much, but if you eat dinner late, you may wonder what you are doing after running the dishwasher and rubbing your sleepy eyes. - Regrettable drying Drying is done by blowing the wind once to blow away the moisture, and then evaporating the moisture at high temperature. Since it only evaporates the moisture, the drying effect is greatly reduced if water is accumulated. If water is accumulated in the concave area at the bottom of the dish, the moisture in that area remains. Regular drying takes about 5 minutes, and most cups and dishes dry well. However, about 50% are dried well, and half of them have one or two drops of water, so it is difficult to put them in the cupboard right away. If you run the strong dry mode, it will dry for 30 minutes, and 80-90% of the items will be dried well, and only a small amount of laundry will have moisture left. I don't want to bother checking whether it's dry or not, so I use the normal dry mode for drying, and after washing, I put it on a drying tray and let it dry naturally. [Overall] - Buy 30 minutes to 1 hour of free time every day with money - If you're not a single-person household, the dishwasher is an unbeatable 12-person option - It's a good choice if you can overlook some of the shortcomings. Note - If you want to install it under the cooking range, it doesn't matter if you use a gas range, but if you use an induction or highlight, they say there's an additional cost for adding insulation between the dishwasher. - If you tell the installer about the lower cabinet of the sink that was removed during installation, they will collect it for free. - The furniture installer first visits for the installation, disassembling the lower cabinet, wiring, and cutting the hole under the sink. Then, the dishwasher installer comes 1-2 days later. There was no installation fee or delivery fee. If you request a previous installation + reassemble the lower cabinet, it will cost around 100,000 won. It is said that an amount of money of that level is generated

Comments (English): [ A hard-working aunt from 2020 ] || ---------------- || It's been two weeks since I've been with Auntie Dishwasher. During the Lunar New Year holiday, I was cooking various dishes at home and washing dishes when suddenly I got a dishwasher. I went to the department store that day and saw LG and Samsung dishwashers, but both of them cost 1.7 million won. 'I'm the only one who doesn't have a dishwasher. ' I searched Coupang and found a good dishwasher for 700,000 won (with card discount). I thought something was strange and checked the details page, but this product was a 2020 model. The department store was a 2021 model. I asked a department store employee for nearly an hour and asked them carefully. I will start a comparative review between the 2021 model and the 2020 model that I actually used for 2 weeks. The review was written in the order of [Pros], [Cons], and [Overall]. [Pros] - It is cheap. It is about 1 million won cheaper than the 2021 model, but there were three major differences between the two. 1. Addition of a dedicated cutlery tray at the top. The 2020 product was washed by placing the cutlery container in the bottom pot washing compartment, which was a bit disappointing. In the 12-person lower pot tray, excluding the cutlery container, you can put in 1 28cm wok, 1 30cm pan, 1 air fryer inner pot & oil pan, and 1 pan lid. However, if you put in a spoon holder, the size is ambiguous, so you have to take one or two out. The size of the spoon holder is not large, but it is the main reason why the difficulty of Tetris increases rapidly. Also, you have to be careful about where you put the spoons in so that they do not stick to each other in the spoon tray, which is inconvenient. Also, since it is a vertically inserted method, long items such as chopsticks for frying or a spatula get caught on the watering can in the middle and cannot be put in. The 2021 model has a 3-tier tray dedicated to cutlery, so it is convenient because you can just unfold it. 1. Application of water softener filter The 2021 products include a water softener function. Was it LG or Samsung? One company purchased a water softener filter, and the other company only added salt to use it, so the two companies had different forms. However, in places with poor water quality such as Europe or Southeast Asia, a water softener function may be necessary, but is it really necessary in Korea? 3. Without removing the mop holder. For those who live in a rented house, cutting the mop holder can be a problem, but the 2021 model can be installed without cutting the mop holder. The 2020 model must be cut. The three things above were big differences, but in my case, they were shortcomings that I could overlook, so I chose the 2020 model. - Bravo cleaning power I was a distruster of dishwashers, but after actually using it, I found out that it had satisfactory cleaning power. At first, I used to wash it beforehand, but I got lazy and stopped doing that. In particular, I fell in love with the cleaning power when I saw that it completely washed away stubborn grease, such as from air fryer whole pork belly. When I first used it because I was not good at dish Tetris, I was embarrassed because there were some places that weren't cleaned, but after arranging the dishes to match the water nozzle and washing them, they became very clean. - Free time. In the past, I used to wash the dishes for lunch and dinner separately. However, when I used the dishwasher, After purchasing it, I have been saving up enough for two meals and running it at once. After dinner, I just throw the dishes in the dishwasher, finish watching Netflix, and when I come out of the shower, I can see the washed dishes shortly - less burden from dishes piling up. Since I can wash pots and dishes without getting my hands wet even if I use them a lot, I don't feel burdened by using new dishes. Since the dishwasher aunt came, there are many cases where all the woks and pans in the house are mobilized. [Cons] - Washing dishes by hand has become a very, very, very annoying thing. In the past, I used to wash the dishes right after eating, but these days, washing dishes by hand is so annoying. Plastic containers, cutting boards, knives, scissors, etc. that cannot be dishwashed must be washed by hand, which is very annoying. I am looking into replacing all of them with dishwasher-safe products. - The washing time is quite long. If you run the regular course, it takes about an hour and a half. On oily days, if you run the soaking + strong wash, it takes more than 2 hours. If you eat dinner early and run it, it does not matter much, but if you eat dinner late, you may wonder what you are doing after running the dishwasher and rubbing your sleepy eyes. - Regrettable drying Drying is done by blowing the wind once to blow away the moisture, and then evaporating the moisture at high temperature. Since it only evaporates the moisture, the drying effect is greatly reduced if water is accumulated. If water is accumulated in the concave area at the bottom of the dish, the moisture in that area remains. Regular drying takes about 5 minutes, and most cups and dishes dry well. However, about 50% are dried well, and half of them have one or two drops of water, so it is difficult to put them in the cupboard right away. If you run the strong dry mode, it will dry for 30 minutes, and 80-90% of the items will be dried well, and only a small amount of laundry will have moisture left. I don't want to bother checking whether it's dry or not, so I use the normal dry mode for drying, and after washing, I put it on a drying tray and let it dry naturally. [Overall] - Buy 30 minutes to 1 hour of free time every day with money - If you're not a single-person household, the dishwasher is an unbeatable 12-person option - It's a good choice if you can overlook some of the shortcomings. Note - If you want to install it under the cooking range, it doesn't matter if you use a gas range, but if you use an induction or highlight, they say there's an additional cost for adding insulation between the dishwasher. - If you tell the installer about the lower cabinet of the sink that was removed during installation, they will collect it for free. - The furniture installer first visits for the installation, disassembling the lower cabinet, wiring, and cutting the hole under the sink. Then, the dishwasher installer comes 1-2 days later. There was no installation fee or delivery fee. If you request a previous installation + reassemble the lower cabinet, it will cost around 100,000 won. It is said that an amount of money of that level is generated

Sentence (English): This dishwasher performs exactly as advertised.
Comments (English): [ A great "little" dishwasher. ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher performs exactly as advertised. The machine was easy to set up and install. The instructions were easy to understand. I did the installation myself. It came well packaged. We put it under a utility counter, so installing it under a counter built for a dishwasher would be easier yet. Leveling and leg adjustment was also very easy. We could sense no steam or dampness being released under the counter. It is very quiet. We had a commercial dishwasher before, and we and our guests had to move two rooms away to have a conversation. The cycle is long, about two hours. But the dishes, including silverware comes out clean. After about 20 loads we have had two items that required hand wash assistance. That is great. One item was a baked cheese and pasta dish. This still only required light scrubbing. We have been scrapping the plates, but we do not rinse them. Even dried egg yolk comes off the plates. We are very pleased with the dishwasher in form, fit, and function. We frequently have guests, 4 to 6 a night. The machine is getting a good workout. We have only had the dishwasher a month. So far it has been an excellent performer and purchase. Although our commercial dishwasher would run a rack in two minutes, it was very noisy, and manpower intensive. The steam released into the area was troublesome and the condensation had to be wiped down. Several dishes a load would have to be done over. The chemical soap and rinse chemicals were very caustic and could burn the skin and required safety glasses to change containers. This Bosch 300 series does a better job and requires much less attention. The Bosch was a little expensive compared to other machines, but thus far has been the best dishwasher we have owned. It is 1/6th the cost of the commercial under the counter dishwasher. My wife is happy with the machine and thus I am happy. We highly recommend this dishwasher.

Comments (English): [ SHE53B75UC is a Problem Unit - DO NOT Reccomend ] || ---------------- || I have owned the SHE53B75UC for 2 months. I absoloutely hate it and want to return it but the local dealer where I bought in Monmouth County, New Jersey won't let me. First the front panel of the dishwasher intermittnely flashes so the Operating module was replaced. That did not work so the operating module is supposed to be replaced AGAIN along with the power module. Also, sometimes when we hit the power button, all of the lights flash on and off (for what seems like a few minutes) and there's no way to stop it. Additionally, the dishwasher does not dry very well and if feel that the dishes are very wet (and yes Bosch customer service, I have followed all of the suggestions including adding a rinse aid). A new heat pump is now on order so that it can be replaced When the dishwasher was delivered there was a dent on the panel so Bosch sent a new panel which was also damaged. The bottom line here is that it seems like Bosch would rather spend what is probably the equalient or MORE money on repairs and labor instead of letting me return the unit. I would even be willing to buy a more expensive BOSCH replacement unit but instead I'm stuck with a dud. This is not the expereince and quality that I thought that I was going to get after reading extensive reviews. I am so very disappointed with BOSCH and this experience. I'm hoping that someone senior at Bosch actually reads these reviews. Mr. Christofer von Nagel, CEO can you help?

Next time will get the Bosch that everyone recommended to me.

Comments (English): [ Noisy, doesn't clean, wet dishes ] || ---------------- || I don't understand how anyone can give this dishwasher higher than a 1 ⭐ review. To start, the dishwasher looks very sleek and modern when installed under the counter, but unfortunately aesthetics are the only accolades I can give this dishwasher. My first gripe about this dishwasher is that it's marketed as extremely quiet during operation, however, that simply isn't true and is quite the opposite. I often times find myself having to turn the TV volume up when the dishwasher is on AND I can't run it at night because the loud motors keep me up at night. If you could schedule the Dishwasher to turn at a certain time, it would serve as the perfect $1,200 alarm clock. Next, I would say the washer does a mediocre job of cleaning the dishes (2 out of 5 stars. would not recommend). WRONG! But let's move on. To add insult to injury, the not only are the dishes still dirty, they're not dry. at all! Everyone considering buying this dishwasher, take my word for it and DON'T BUY IT. You will be disappointed with a noisy, overpriced, underperforming alarm clock that thinks it's a dishwasher.

If it wasn't, we would literally have a paper weight. To purchase the Control Board is $251, to ship it was $55, and to get an approved repairman to install it, $150. More than half the cost of the original purchase, just over 3 years after purchase, to fix it. Don't buy this. Also, don't buy anything from LG. our clothing washer also just bit it (but that was a $60 part, and the repairman probably felt bad for us, so he didn't charge us the service call. ) Now. we have a paper weight.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher performs exactly as advertised.
Comments (English): [ A great "little" dishwasher. ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher performs exactly as advertised.The machine was easy to set up and install. The instructions were easy to understand. I did the installation myself. It came well packaged. We put it under a utility counter, so installing it under a counter built for a dishwasher would be easier yet. Leveling and leg adjustment was also very easy. We could sense no steam or dampness being released under the counter. It is very quiet. We had a commercial dishwasher before, and we and our guests had to move two rooms away to have a conversation. The cycle is long, about two hours. But the dishes, including silverware comes out clean. After about 20 loads we have had two items that required hand wash assistance. That is great. One item was a baked cheese and pasta dish. This still only required light scrubbing. We have been scrapping the plates, but we do not rinse them. Even dried egg yolk comes off the plates.We are very pleased with the dishwasher in form, fit, and function. We frequently have guests, 4 to 6 a night. The machine is getting a good workout. We have only had the dishwasher a month. So far it has been an excellent performer and purchase.Although our commercial dishwasher would run a rack in two minutes, it was very noisy, and manpower intensive. The steam released into the area was troublesome and the condensation had to be wiped down. Several dishes a load would have to be done over. The chemical soap and rinse chemicals were very caustic and could burn the skin and required safety glasses to change containers. This Bosch 300 series does a better job and requires much less attention.The Bosch was a little expensive compared to other machines, but thus far has been the best dishwasher we have owned. It is 1/6th the cost of the commercial under the counter dishwasher.My wife is happy with the machine and thus I am happy. We highly recommend this dishwasher.

Sentence (English): We were looking at different dishwashers, but my wife was drawn to this one so we purchased it.
Comments (English): [ Quiet, but powerful cleaning ] || ---------------- || We were looking at different dishwashers, but my wife was drawn to this one so we purchased it. I am very glad that we did. It is a very quiet machine with many features. There are plenty of cycles to choose from. The racks are quality and roll smoothly. The tines seem to be flexible enough not to break, but aren't flimsy either. The exterior is very easy to clean. The QuadWash Pro system does a superior job at cleaning the dishes. I have had very few dishes not come clean. I did note that Finish detergent pods work better than Cascade in this machine. The dishes come out dry 99% of the time as well. One must make sure to have glasses and plasticware tipped so water will not collect, and they will come out dry as well (I do use the extra dry function most of the time). My only gripe would be the two screw holes in the sides for mounting. They are recessed and if you need to remove the screw, it is hard to get it out of the frame. For those complaining that the cycles take too long, it's a dishwasher. I do not feel they are too long at all. I do run mine at night mostly though. I highly recommend this machine.

Comments (English): [ Worst quality ever ] || ---------------- || We have bought all the LG appliances when we moved into the new house so the kitchen would match. Exactly 3 years later the dishwasher is done ,the motor burnt. Since I accidentally purchased the dishwasher with another credit card and not the Costco card, there is no extended warranty so precisely three years =no more dishwasher. From the starters that dishwasher had issues. The control panel would randomly freeze and I would have to go underneath the kitchen cabinet to unplug it from the outlet to restart the whole thing. A few times the drain would not work. I had to readjust the hose. Overall, the washing was fine ,drying completely sucked. Not just plastic , but the regular dishes as well , the third rack is a great idea but in reality it doesn't really do much. Overall I would not recommend the dishwasher to anyone. We had a Bosch dishwasher before that was very quiet very efficient and had never had any complaints and never broke down. In our old house we had that old old and i mean old GE dishwasher that looks like the ones from the movies and was running for 30 years and never had a problem .to burn the motor in three years it's a major fault .

The track/rails feel cheap, which doesn't match well with expensive dishes. If I had only plasticware, then maybe I wouldn't care so much that the drawers fly at lightning speed open and close and slam open/shut. Adding a soft open/close would solve the problem. Comments (English): [ BEST DISHWASHER EVER!  ] || ---------------- || Long story short - we had THREE KitchenAid dishwashers within the last 7 months. The company had terrible customer service and basically continued to give us delays and lemons of a dishwasher. I sent the last dishwasher back and knew I needed to buy something with a better track record. So of course I looked to Bosch. Let me tell you, this dishwasher right here is hands down the quietest dishwasher ever. The red light shining on the floor lets you know it's running - and when that cycle is done your dishes, silverware, serveware, glasses are SPOT LESS. Sentence (English): We've had this dishwasher for 2 months now, and highly recommend it.
Comments (English): [ Washes Dishes Silently ] || ---------------- || We've had this dishwasher for 2 months now, and highly recommend it. With a family of 5 where we prepare and cook at least 2 meals a day, we needed a workhorse that could handle at least one full cycle daily, and this dishwasher has not disappointed us yet. Pro: Silent - the layout of our kitchen opens up into our dining and living rooms, so any noise can disrupt either space. This dishwasher is extremely quiet, almost silent. The illuminated red dot, and occasional water supply line sounds are the only indication that the dishwasher is on. Pro: Efficient - First time owning a Bosch dishwasher, in the past we had to rinse (sometimes scrub) all the dishes and cups to get them clean. Now, we just scrape the dishes and load them, with excellent results every time. We mostly use the Speed 60 minute wash, and have had no issues with the cleanliness of the dishes. Pro: Sturdy construction - the door latch is very distinct and feels very well sealed when shut. Other brands/models would have steam vents or notice slight water vapour escape from the door, but not this one. The stainless steel tub also prevents odours and stains from forming in the machine. As well, the easily removable middle rack allows for easy washing of tall items like drink pitchers and baking sheets. Con: Lack of features that are standard in other mid/higher end dishwasher models like an interior light or a display that shows time remaining for the wash cycle. Despite the description for the model of the LED program display counter, as soon as the dishwasher cycle is started, the display shuts off and cannot show cycle time remaining or status of wash cycle. Con: Drying plasticware - Just doesn't dry the plastic items like bowls and food storage containers as well as other dishwashers even with the rinse-aid added. Overall, an excellent dishwasher that I would highly recommend.

Comments (English): [ Think twice before purchasing ] || ---------------- || Usually love LG products but don't buy this dishwasher! Purchased this dishwasher in April 2023. The first problem is the rollers on the bottom rack—half of the time it falls off of the track and it is hard to get in and out. The design of the bottom rack doesn't seem very logical and it is hard to organize dishes with an extra space where dishes fall through—almost like it's missing a row of prongs to hold plates. I don't love how the top rack loads either. The dishwasher also does not dry well, even though we use the extra dry cycle that takes 3 hours to wash and dry the dishes. We still have to hand dry several of dishes. The dishwasher turns on easily even if you just brush up against the Power button when you're not meaning to turn it on. Does it wash the dishes—yes, but if you have another option, I would choose the other option if I had to do it over. Definitely would not buy again and would NOT recommend to others either! SUPER DISAPPOINTED with this dishwasher.

Sentence (English): We have now had our dishwasher for about a month and have discovered a few things.
Comments (English): [ Bosch 300 Series Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || We have now had our dishwasher for about a month and have discovered a few things. Firstly, I/we noticed that it is amost impossible to tell if the unit is running. Water ingress is extremely quiet as well as any of the wash cycles. The only part of running that is noticed is water being pumped out in to the drain. Secondly, what we noticed is that if the dishes are not rinsed prior to loading into the machine the possibility of non-clean dishes exists. While the silverware container is moveable to accomodate different lower level placement accomodations, which is great, it does mean that there exists a possibility of non-clean silverware if a large plate is put in front of the silverware container. Maybe just a learning curve for the owner. Lastly, the biggest bugaboo found regarding this dishwasher is the fact that there are/is no indicatior alerting the fact taht the machine has completed it's assigned task. Therefore, clean dishes could be sitting in a damp machine for days before being found out it had run. Other than that there have been no problems noted. Works great, is extremely quiet, and a non-functional part. looks great! Oh, one last thing. this machine has a filter that must being removed and cleaned periodically. Our old machine had a masticator that ground the bits up before sending them down the drain. I can't believe that an 25 year old Kemore would have had a convenience like this and not Bosch.

Sentence (English): In a previous house, I installed a similar Bosch dishwasher, and loved it.
Comments (English): [ Quiet and great at washing dishes ] || ---------------- || In a previous house, I installed a similar Bosch dishwasher, and loved it. This house, however, came with a S. ung dishwasher that did NOT clean dishes nearly as well, even on heavy cycle. I was kind of happy when it needed a repair (10 years old), and instead I decided to see what Bosch had available. This one seemed to tick almost all of my boxes, so I ordered it, hoping that it was as good as the old one (which had 2 pumps). It's even quieter, takes about the same amount of time, and cleans quite well. Dried on oatmeal? No soak, no problem! And remember, people used to make PASTE out of oatmeal (sort of). The third (upper) tier for silverware and other flat things is great! I wasn't sure how well the water would get up there, but once again, dried-on oatmeal, gone! If you're wondering if that's a strange little hand-hold on the middle rack (glasses etc), it's actually where you'd toss a detergent pod, rather than using the door. My minor complaints are that the door spring is really quite strong/tight, so I can't just leave it ajar to let the humid air out for the final drying of the dishes. The other is that with the controls on top, there's no real way to pause it before opening the door, so you have to use just the right force to open it a teensy bit, allowing the water to stop and drain down, if you need to add something after you've started it. To be fair, I knew about that before buying it, but combined with the door spring, it's more of an annoyance than I thought it would be. I also miss being able to see how much longer the cycle will run. Perhaps one of their future evolutions will display that on the floor, instead of just a red dot. And yes, it really is quiet enough that I sometimes have to look at the floor to see if there's a red dot (on) or not. No issues running it and watching tv in the attached family room. I would buy this again! And remember, scrape, don't rinse!

If I could give it 3 and a half stars, I think that would be more fair, especially since this is a pretty expensive dishwasher.Good points are:- It cleans well, as long as you use the recommended detergent pods and do a little bit of pre-rinsing and brushing of dishes- It's quiet enough that you don't need to raise the TV volume to hear over the dishwasher noise- It's easy to operate- The door stays open if you open it slightly after a load to let your dishes air dry- You can put a LOT of dishes in it! This is probably the best feature of the dishwasher. Having the glasses on the top rack really frees up a lot of room for pots and pans in the middle rack.- The adjustable middle rack is a nice feature- The racks roll smoothlySome less than satisfactory things are:- The top 2 racks sag when you pull them out. This is a problem on the top rack because glasses and small bowls slide forward every time I pull the top rack out.- The holes in the cutlery basket are mostly too small to accommodate the handles of our cutlery. Fortunately, I saved the basket from our old dishwasher, and that's what I'm continuing to use. Also, the sections of the basket that are meant for larger items are too small to fit some items that I used to put in our old basket, such as plastic lids that might fly around and the blade attachment of our blender.- The cycle lengths are very long. There is the Express Wash cycle, which is shorter, but it actually uses more water than any other cycle, so I never use it. Something like a Light Wash resource-efficient cycle for small, lightly-soiled loads would be a great idea. The Pro Wash cycle always takes at least 2.5 hrs, no matter what.- I don't know if there's something wrong with our machine, but it makes an annoying, high-pitched hum during certain parts of the cycle that I can hear from the 2nd floor of the house. It's hard to be in the same room with it sometimes. It's not a loud noise, but it's very penetrating. The decibel level is still in the mid 40s though.- The shallow part of the upper rack doesn't receive enough water to clean heavily-soiled, deep items, such as measuring cups. There needs to be a better water spray that hits dishes from the bottom, rather than just the one spray arm at the top of the machine. The rotating bars that clean the glasses don't seem to spray far enough to clean the underside of the whole top rack.- The handle on the removable tray on the top rack is unnecessary and just takes up otherwise usable space. - The chime that indicates the cycle end needs to be a little bit louderOverall, I'd still recommend this dishwasher. We've only had it for a little over a month, so I can't comment on how long it will last. I've also never used the dry cycle, so I don't know how well it works.

Sentence (English): The GE Profile dishwasher is everything that I expected and more.
Comments (English): [ Same amazing quality I have come to expect ] || ---------------- || The GE Profile dishwasher is everything that I expected and more. There is an assumption of quality that comes with the GE brand and this does not disappoint. Installation was relatively simple, my husband had the old out and this one in within an hour and a half. We were mildly confused, as we were instructed to hook up to the hot water line, BUT it is fantastic! The unit fits flush in the space, almost disappearing into the cabinetry. The fingerprint resistant finish is just that, I have tried to do my best and am unable to leave it printy and smudgy. Cleanup of the face of the dishwasher is as easy as a damp cloth to wipe it down. The bottle jets can be turned on when in use and are fantastic. There are clips that hold bottles or whatever you are putting on them (travel mugs) in place and the directed jet gets them cleaner than a standard top rack wash would. The silverware basket fits over another set of dedicated jets, meaning the silverware isn't missed EVER, no matter how full the dishwasher is. The top shelf (third) also has its own rotating water jets making the use of the upper shelf more realistic, leaving the utensils on that shelf clean everytime. Finally, the app. Who knew that an app for a dishwasher would be so useful. #1 I know if it has been run while I am away (hubby and I are terrible at telling each other)#2. It keeps track of how many pods we have left, so I can just check the app if I don't remember if we are running low. #3 You can lock your favorite cycle, so that it is used each time. #4 You get a monthly maintenance report that even tells you how many gallons of water you have used. All in all I cannot say enough good things about this dishwasher. 10/10 Absolutely recommend.

Sentence (English): Our previous Bosch dishwasher has now given up the ghost after more than 10 years.
Comments (English): [ Economical and quiet dish dryer ] || ---------------- || Our previous Bosch dishwasher has now given up the ghost after more than 10 years. Convinced by the brand, we have now also chosen a Bosch dishwasher. At first we were skeptical because we previously had a cutlery basket, but now we have a cutlery drawer. After filling it for the first time, we don't want to change the cutlery drawer. We have gained space for plates or pots and more than enough space for the cutlery. It works perfectly and the "Silent" is absolutely fantastic. All dishes are cleaned and dried with almost no noise. A very quiet dish dryer that also saves between 1 and 2 KW per drying compared to the "old" one. Highly recommended.
Comments (Original): [ Sparsamer und leiser Geschirrtrockner ] || ---------------- || Unser bisheriger Geschirrspüler von Bosch hat nun nach mehr als 10 Jahren den Geist aufgegeben. Von der Marke überzeugt nun ebenfalls einen Bosch Geschirrspüler gewählt. Zunächst skeptisch, da wir bisher einen Besteckkorb hatten, nun mit Besteckschublade. Schon nach dem ersten Befüllen möchten wir die Besteckschublade nicht mehr eintauschen. Gewonnener Platz für Teller oder Töpfe und mehr als ausreichen Platz für das Besteck. Funktion perfekt und das 'Silent' absolut traumhaft. Nahezu geräuschlos wird jegliches Geschirr super gereinigt und getrocknet. Ein sehr leiser Geschirrtrockner, der auch noch pro Trocknung zwischen 1 und 2 KW, im Vergleich zum 'Alten', einspart. Sehr zu empfehlen.

Sentence (English): After the old dishwasher drain broke (and ruined the laminate floor) it was time for a new dishwasher!
Comments (English): [ Lots of space for everything ] || ---------------- || After the old dishwasher drain broke (and ruined the laminate floor) it was time for a new dishwasher! My parents actually have the same one, which I didn't know until after we had purchased it. Fortunately my Dad was able to give us access to the inside pass, and it made this less expensive than the big box stores. I did the installation myself, the instructions leave a lot to be desired. Maybe I was missing a page but I had no idea where to connect the drain tube. Thankfully there's YouTube. The other difficult part was hardwiring the power, ideally you'd have it laid on its back but that wasn't possible with the amount of slack I had in the wiring. I'm surprised how long the wash cycle is, a couple hours! And I'm not too keen on needing to leave the door open so all the water dries within, otherwise it'll stay wet in there. But I'm a huge fan of the 3rd rack for silverware!

Fortunately my Dad was able to give us access to the inside pass, and it made this less expensive than the big box stores. I did the installation myself, the instructions leave a lot to be desired. Maybe I was missing a page but I had no idea where to connect the drain tube. Thankfully there's YouTube. The other difficult part was hardwiring the power, ideally you'd have it laid on its back but that wasn't possible with the amount of slack I had in the wiring. I'm surprised how long the wash cycle is, a couple hours!? And I'm not too keen on needing to leave the door open so all the water dries within, otherwise it'll stay wet in there. But I'm a huge fan of the 3rd rack for silverware!
